articleTitle: A Knowledge-Based Filtering Recommendation System for Personalized Teaching Resources in Ideological and Political Theories in All Courses in English Courses
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, the rapid growth of Information Technology (IT) advancements, various network sciences and personalized learning has become a new trend in modern education. However, a multi-dimensional evaluation feedback system is lacking on learning in school ideological and political education, and failing to provide sufficient carrier support to enhance educational effectiveness. Hence, this research provides a Knowledge-Based Filtering Recommendation System for Personalized Teaching Resources in Ideological and Political Theories teaching in all courses English Courses (KBF-PTRIP). This research has taken input data from Edx dataset and given to content extraction as user input. Here, the user inputs are analyzed and the similarity between learning resources and individual learners is calculated to provide the prediction score. Then, Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) method is exploited to select best features with the highest prediction score. Finally, the personalized teaching resources are recommended to the user with the help of Knowledge-Based Filtering (KBF) recommender. From the results, the proposed KBF- PTRIP model achieved best results in terms of accuracy 98.82%, recall 98.73% and F1 score 96.35% respectively by comparing with the existing Primary and Secondary Education Resource System by using Collaborative Filtering (PSERS-CF) model.

Author Keywords: teaching resources for ideological and political theories teaching in all courses in english courses

articleTitle: Categorization of Brain Tumor Using CNN from 2D MRI Scan Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the realm of medical imaging, accurate identification, delineation, and categorization of brain tumors are of paramount significance for prompt intervention and treatment planning. This pioneering research introduces an innovative framework that harnesses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Efficient neural network, Residual Network, and Mobile Network architectures for 2D brain tumor analysis. Deployment of deep learning methodologies to augment precision and furnish valuable insights for medical practitioners. The proposed methodology integrates skipconnection and encoder-decoder architectures, bolstered by data augmentation strategies. Grounded in tumors delineated by experts, particularly within a low-grade glioma (LGG) patient cohort, the framework extrapolates intrinsic affinities to synthesize thousands of representative cases. The efficacy of the proposed approach is substantiated through metrics such as pixel accuracy, F1 score, and MCL. Mobile Network Stood out in our comparative investigation, demonstrating its advantage in classification accuracy. Furthermore, this study sheds light on the consequential impact of brain tumor analysis, offering a promising avenue for advancing diagnostic capabilities and treatment outcomes in the field of neuro-oncology.

articleTitle: Identification of Power Information Network System Vulnerabilities by using Cascading Failure Analysis and Differential Evaluation with Maturity Factor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, the power systems becoming a vital component in the modern society, which is playing a critical role in sustaining daily life. However, the vulnerabilities of these power systems are exposed through unforeseen accidents or intentional attacks and the compromising reliability. In existing, with the widespread application of data mining technology, the vulnerabilities are identified with various optimizations such as Genetic Algorithm (GA), which are mainly suffered with low convergence. To overcome this issue, Cascading Failure Analysis and Differential Evaluation with Maturity Factor (CFA-DE-MF) proposed for vulnerability identification. Initially, the Cascading Failure Analysis (CFA) is introduced to find the potential failures that are present in the power information network security. Next, the convergence sets are removed if any overload branches exist. After that, the criticality/ importance are ranked with the help of two techniques to rank the failures into high, medium or low. The considered techniques are Dynamic Network Stability (DNS) and Branch Overload Frequency (BOF), which rank the failures based on DNS metrics and frequency overload. Finally, the vulnerabilities are identified with the help of Differential Evaluation with Maturity Factor (DE-MF) optimization. From the results, the proposed CFA-DE-MF established better results such as Area Under Curve (AUC) (99.1%), accuracy (97.5%) and F1-score (75.9%) respectively.

Author Keywords: identification of power information network security vulnerabilities

articleTitle: Machine Automatic Translation System Based on Artificial Intelligence Processor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the era of deepening globalization, the demand for machine automated translation systems is growing, as they facilitate cross-linguistic communication. However, these systems often struggle with accuracy, contextual fluency, and personalization, limiting their effectiveness. This study addresses these shortcomings by leveraging the bidirectional training capabilities of artificial intelligence processors and BERT models. Our approach effectively captures nuances in the source language, enabling the generation of natural and fluent target language text. Additionally, the parallel computing capabilities of these processors significantly accelerate translation speed, meeting real-time translation demands. We also train personalized translation models through user behavior analysis, catering to diverse user preferences in translation style. Our experimental results demonstrate a substantial improvement in the BLEU score compared to traditional phrase-based statistical machine translation, rule-based machine translation, and early neural machine translation methods. Specifically, the system achieves a BLEU score that is significantly higher, indicating improved accuracy and fluency. In terms of speed, the system can process 1000 words in as fast as 0.45 seconds, showcasing its efficiency. The personalized translation effects are also significant, further enhancing the system's adaptability to individual user needs. These findings validate the effectiveness of artificial intelligence processors in enhancing machine automated translation systems and highlight their potential for diverse translation applications.

articleTitle: Heart Sound Classification Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Heart sound classification involves the analysis of recorded heart sounds to distinguish between normal and abnormal rhythms, providing valuable insights for the diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases. Accurate classification of heart sounds plays a vital role in the diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases by identifying characteristic noises produced as the heart beats. These heart sounds are typically captured using stethoscopes, and advanced signal processing techniques are applied to categorize sounds into various classes: normal heartbeats, systolic murmurs, or diastolic murmurs. Deep Machine (DL) and Machine Learning (ML) methods. ML methods such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), typically rely on manually designed audio data that include frequency components or temporal patterns. Conversely, Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks are two examples of deep learning (DL) models that automate feature extraction and learn directly from spectrograms or raw audio. Combining CNNs' attention to spatial patterns in the data, along with the LSTMs' capacity to capture temporal relationships, improves the accuracy and consistency of heart sound analysis for early diagnosis and detection.

articleTitle: Image Denoising Technology Using Fast and Flexible Denoising Network with Non Local Means
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Since years, image denoising plays an important role restoring pristine images from corrupted ones captured digital cameras by ensuring reliable input for high level applications. Traditional approaches for image noising had faced several challenges which include limited noise removal capability, difficulty in handling non-Gaussian noise. Therefore, this research proposes (FFDNet-NLM) for image denoising technology which is employed on SARBM-3D dataset. As this data contains noise, the data is preprocessed by utilizing image normalization which effectively reduces the impact of variations in lighting, contrast and noise. Then, the data is validated by using DnCNN-UNet which efficiently removes Gaussian and non-Gaussian noise by enhancing signal to noise ratio and retained data characteristics. After that, the data is trained by using FFDNet which efficiently removed additive noise and fast interference enabling real time image denoising in NLM. Finally, the combined FFDNet-NLM recovered finer details and textures in image with self-similarity to ensure speed and adaptability varying noise levels and suppressing residual blocks by improved robustness in image denoising. Experimental results of the proposed FFDNet-NLM method attained PSNR (36.05) and SSIM (0.89) are higher than existing method for image denoising techniques such as K-Singular Value Decomposition (K-SVD) and weighted iterative shrinkage thresholding algorithm (WISTA).

articleTitle: Improved Flower Pollination Algorithm Based Optimum Design of Reinforced Concrete Retaining Walls
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In civil works, the structural design is thoroughly tied into experiential knowledge and design experiences. According to the suitable design are produced to durability, operability, strength. The Improved Flower Pollination Algorithm (IFPA) mimics the process of flower species and its update mechanism is derivative from flowers pollination process. The Reinforced Concrete (RC) retaining wall attaining an optimum solutions. To overcome this, the IFPA into optimal structural design of retaining wall with 6 autonomous design variables are determined. It significantly minimizes the wall cost according to IFPA parameters and produces better performance. The result quality enhanced for p values among 0.4-0.8. The better IFPA is attained through applying switch probability p=0.5 subsequently it displays both minimum variation coefficients and best average costs. The maximum, average and minimum costs are attained through six IFPA and its variation coefficients. Lastly, the parametric optimum design demonstrates that optimal cost of RC retain wall enhances by wall height.

articleTitle: Logistic Financial Risk Evaluation Based on Sparse Factor Analysis with Horse Herd Optimization and TensorFlow Decision Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, the logistics industry played an important role in global trade by facilitating the movement of goods and services across international borders. This logistic financial risks arise from uncertainties in the transportation system and supply chain disruptions. Traditional approaches for evaluating logistic financial risk had faced several challenges which includes regulatory compliance and supply chain disruptions. Therefore, this paper proposes Space Factor Analysis-Horse Herd Optimization-TensorFlow Decision Forest (SFA-HHO-TFDT) approach for logistic financial risk evaluation which is employed on financial risk dataset which taken from the China Stock Market & Accounting Research (CSMAR) database. This data is preprocessed by using min-max normalization to normalize the data since it is used for scaling the data into particular ranges. Then, SFA is employed for analyzing factor analysis to extract factors. After that, HHO is utilized for selecting optimal factors to enhance the performance of evaluation model accurately. Finally, TFDT is employed to evaluate optimal factors efficiently and logistic financial risks. This SFA-HHO-TFDT effectively reduced the supply chain disruptions and effectively achieved in terms of MSE (0.0029), MAPE (2.1987) and MAE (0.0489) respectively.

articleTitle: Novel Analysis of Human Stress Using Adult Blood Pressure and Heart Rate Data Using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Aim: This study uses the Novel Random Forest (RF) algorithm to identify mental stress in adult patients. Heart rate and blood pressure (systolic and diastolic) measurements are utilized to identify mental stress. Materials and Methods: A total of 108402 samples are taken from the Stress Detection of Medical Practitioners dataset, which is hosted on Kaggle. Clincalc, which has two distinct groups, alpha (0.05), power (80<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), and enrollment ratio, is used to compute the G power for samples. The training dataset (n = 75882) comprises 70% of these samples, whereas the test dataset (n = 32520) comprises 30% of them. To measure how well the RF algorithm performs, accuracy is computed. Results: When it came to the stress detection of medical practitioners and human stress detection datasets, the novel RF method achieved an accuracy of 90.4 % and 88.2%, respectively, whereas logistic regression earned an accuracy of 87.4% and 85.3% (P<0.05). The G power is calculated as 0.8. Conclusion: The results of this investigation show that the RF algorithm outperforms the LR method by a large margin.

articleTitle: Analysis of Equipment Health Status Based on Vibration Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The health status of tobacco equipment is crucial for the normal operation of industrial production and social life. By collecting, processing, and analyzing equipment vibration signals, we can obtain information on the operating status of the equipment, and thus determine its health status. This article analyzes the requirements for a device health monitoring system and designs its hardware and software. The vibration signal acquisition module consists of vibration sensors, signal conditioning circuits, digital signal processors, and data acquisition cards. We choose the CA-YD-185 piezoelectric vibration accelerometer as the sensor for collecting vibration signals. The monitoring service terminal selects the Hilbert transform method to transform and process vibration signals, and extracts equipment status features. The experimental results indicate that vibration detection technology can effectively detect faults and abnormalities in tobacco equipment, providing important reference for equipment maintenance and management. This system can monitor the status of tobacco equipment based on changes in equipment vibration signals, and is suitable for practical applications in tobacco equipment operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: An Interior Space Layout Optimization Based on Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks with GraphSAGE
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Since years, the interior space planning stage typically involves a labor intensive, iterative process that required manually balancing multiple factors, including meeting specific design and aesthetic goals by incorporating professional input, and optimizing design performance for efficiency and user experience. Traditional approaches for interior space layout optimization had face several challenges which include noise in labels, doesn't captured complex relationships. Therefore, this research proposes Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)-GraphSAGE for interior space layout optimization. Initially, the data is taken from Regional Planning and Land Use Analysis Network (RPLAN) dataset. Then, data is preprocessed by using Soft label encoder which effectively captured uncertainty in labels. The preprocessed data is used for room graph generation by using Wasserstein GAN which effectively, generated more realistic room layouts by capturing complex relationships between objects. After that, layout generation is done by using GraphSAGE for capturing complex relationships between objects by enabling contextual layout generation. Finally, design and quality evaluation is done by using space syntax analysis which effectively, analyzed spatial relationships by revealing hidden patterns. The proposed Wasserstein GAN- GraphSAGE established better results, IOU of 0.19, precision 0.48, recall 0.50 when compared with existing Bicycle GAN.

articleTitle: Multiple Chaotic Map Based Selective Image Encryption Scheme for Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Securing medical images is essential to protect patient privacy, particularly with the rise of telemedicine and eHealth/mHealth services, necessitating rapid and effective security measures. However, research on securing medical images with minimal processing time remains limited. This paper presents a selective encryption approach aimed at reducing processing time while ensuring robust security. In the developed scheme of the present study, a selective image security system, using multiple chaotic maps has been incorporated. The Region of Interest is selected either manually or a histogram based global threshold is used. The selected region is then subjected to a 2D logistic map and then XORed with the pseudo random series generated by a 3D Lorentz map. The applying of the diffused image over the input image gives a selectively encrypted image. The proposed novel image encryption scheme in this paper combines both logistic and Lorenz maps to improve the encryption capacity. Our experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method enhances the security performance more effectively than other methods in terms of entropy and correlation coefficients. The adopted encryption strategy also reveals high reliability against the brute force attacks with low processing delay required achieving high entropy and nearly zero correlation coefficients making it appropriate for real-time medical image applications.

articleTitle: Improved Artificial Bee Colony based Compressive Strength Prediction and Optimization in Concrete Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The usage of Silica Fume (SF) and Fly Ash (FA) materials are stated in concrete sample design and it used numerous industrial applications because of the benefit of these materials. Through, the proper usage of correct mixes is a significant factor according to concrete weight and strength. Hence, this paper proposed an Improved Artificial Bee Colony (IABC) algorithm to estimate the concrete CS through laboratory experiments. The database contains SF, FA, Total Cementitious Material (TCM), Age of Samples (AS) and High-Rate Water Reducing Agent (HRWRA) is utilized for estimate and forecast concrete Compressive Strength (CS). The proposed IABC formed a connection among above mentioned parameters. The IABC based on whale dynamic selection probability and search are reached an optimal solution and stable operate reasonable and state ability configuration. In the innovative technique, every parameter influence on CS is defined. Lastly, the IABC algorithm is used for optimal conditions of concrete samples compressive strength is presented and it is able to progress connection which is serve as better replacement for empirical models.

articleTitle: A Compact Nested Triangular Loop Antenna for Quad-band Wireless Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this article, a compact CPW-fed antenna with a triangular nested loop for multiband resonance is presented. It offers compactness and multiband performance by using triangular loop components. The antenna is constructed with four triangular loops, where each loop is responsible for quad-band resonance, and the optimized geometry of the proposed antenna is 20 × 20 × 1.6 mm3, The number of triangular loops is increased with proper optimization, and these iterations of the triangular nested loops create a quad-band resonance centered at 1.28 GHz, 2.95 GHz, 4.42 GHz, and 5.44 GHz with bandwidth of 20 MHz, 90 MHz, 360 MHz, and 630 MHz. In all four resonance frequencies, the proposed antenna exhibits good radiation characteristics and has a radiation efficiency of around 80%. The proposed design resonates for sub 6 GHz 5G, WLAN, WiMAX applications.

articleTitle: Insulation Temperature Monitoring of Distribution Cables Based on Gaussian Process Classifier with Stationary Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In today's era, with global energy demands escalating rapidly, reliable and efficient power distribution systems have become essential. Several methods have been proposed to monitor the temperature of cables which have scalability, limited-spatial resolution, and compliance issues. To overcome these drawbacks, a Gaussian Process Classifier (GPC) is employed to monitor the insulation temperature of distribution cables. To assesses this research, a Temperature Reading: IOT Devices (TR: IID) dataset is incorporated as an input for data preprocessing. Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) along with Hilbert Transform (HT), and Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) are considered for preprocessing to filter background noise, to obtain frequencies and amplitudes of signals, and to reduce frequency overlapping. For feature extraction, a Stationary Wavelet Transform (SWT) is adopted to preserve temporal data, to reduce dimensionality, enhance accuracy, and for efficient computation. The GPC is leveraged as classifier for classification of insulation temperature monitoring to handle missing data, multi-dimensionality, and to enhance scalability, and interpretability. The proposed GPC model obtained high results in the context of precision 99.81%, recall 97.13 %, and F1 score 99.87 % and accuracy 99.72%, when compared to existing methods like Decision Tree (DT).

articleTitle: Simulation of Network Security Situation Awareness based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The internet has become an indispensable infrastructure in modern society, but cybersecurity issues are becoming increasingly prominent. In the current context of the increasing popularity of complex heterogeneous networks, the research results of the security situational awareness problem for complex networks such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and the Internet will be directly related to the normal operation status of these networks, as well as the data information security and privacy protection of the state and individuals. In this paper, the deep neural network algorithm is used to train and model the data of network posture to achieve accurate identification of network attack events. Experimental data shows that the accuracy of the system on the training set, validation set, and test set is 98.5%, 97.8%, and 98.2%, respectively, demonstrating excellent detection and response capabilities. By optimizing the convolutional neural network structure, the system has improved in terms of accuracy, false positive rate, and computational cost. The research results indicate that the platform can effectively enhance the perception ability of network security situation, providing solid technical support for future network security protection.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation for Practical Skill Training for College Students Based on Entropy with Gray Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, the rapid growth of Internet Technology (IT) and information systems leads to a flow in digital creation. As it is necessary to integrate into educational settings to enhance teaching and learning experiences, improving students' practical abilities, the paper proposes a method for evaluating the quality of practical skills training for college students. In existing, Single Factor Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation (SFFCE) is utilized, but accuracy is reduced with assignment of subjective weights. To overcome this problem, Entropy with Gray Relational Analysis (Entropy-GRA) is proposed to eliminate the subjective weights. Initially, the input is produced with Delphi method according to questionnaire manner with panel experts. Then, the entropy method is introduced to evaluate the weights of factors and removes the subjective weights. The entropy method utilizes the data itself to determine the weights, making the process more reliable. Finally, GRA method is employed to construct a matrix that measures the degree of similarity between the evaluation index and the ideal solution. From the results, the proposed Entropy-GRA achieved outperforming results when compared to existing Student Skill Evaluation (SSE) is done with domain grades as excellent, good and poor for factors including technical skills as 65.2, 18.5, 0.3, mental toughness as 76.2, 5.4, 0.6 and physical fitness as 78.9, 10.8, 0.2, tactical awareness as 72.6, 5.2, 1.5 respectively.

Author Keywords: practical skills training for college students

articleTitle: Dipper Throated Optimization with Convolutional Neural Network Based Task Scheduling and Resource Allocation in the Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The progress in the recent technology has shown wide application of cloud computing due to its extensive range of assistances for the users. The functioning of schedule task and allocate the resources in the cloud is affected due to enormous multiple task request. The existing methods tried to overcome the problem of multiple user requests to balance the cloud load but failed to reach the estimated outcome due to limited space searching ability. To overwhelm the existing problem an improved Dipper Throated Optimization with Convolutional Neural Network (DTO-CNN) method is introduced to increase the functioning of task scheduling and resource allocation in the cloud atmosphere. The CNN algorithm was used to predict the task scheduling in the cloud based on their previous history. The DTO algorithm was used for improving space searching ability of the CNN model that improved the schedule task and allocate the resources in the cloud atmosphere. The functioning of the proposed DTO-CNN algorithm is evaluated using throughput, reliability and response time. The developed DTO-CNN has obtained throughput of 307ms, reliability of 0.895 and response time of 991ms for 500 number of tasks compared to the existing FFARS-MSO model.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection System Based on Separable Convolution AutoEncoder with Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, Intrusion Detection System (IDS) that continuously detects, analyzed network traffic for signs of malicious activity by enabling prompt detection and response to potential security incidents. Traditional approaches IDS had faced several challenges which include high false positive rates, limited detection capability. Therefore, this research proposes Separable Convolution AutoEncoder-Long Short-Term Memory (SCAE-LSTM) for network intrusion detection system. Initially, data is taken from Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System (CICIDS) 2018 dataset is preprocessed by using t-Distributed Stochastic Neighboring Embedding (t-SNE) which reduces effectively in high-dimensional network traffic data to a lower dimensional representation. Then, the features are extracted from preprocessed data by using Local Linear Embedding (LLE) which identified nonlinear structures and anomalies that indicated in the network intrusions. After that, classification is done by using SCAE to complex patterns and anomalies in traffic data. Finally, the network intrusions are detected by using LSTM which effectively improves accuracy, reduces false positives, enhances the overall robustness in intrusion detection system. The proposed SCAE-LSTM achieved better accuracy (0.9755), detection rate (0.9999), F1 value (0.9575) and false positive rate (0.0128) when compared with existing CNN-LSTM.

articleTitle: An Image Quality Evaluation Based on Dense Network and Squeeze Excitation Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In todays world., Image quality evaluation is essential in various fields such as medical imaging., security and photography since they capture high-quality visuals that are critical for accurate interpretation and decision-making. Previous researchers suggested various methods in machine learning and deep learning but still there are challenges in computational efficiency and generalizability across diverse image types and applications. This paper proposes a novel approach namely DenseNet169-SENet i.e. Squeeze Excitation Network for image quality evaluation using combination of models such as Median filter., Savitzky-Golay filter., Dense Net and SENet. Initially., the data is accumulated from a public dataset which contains X-ray images. Further., the collected data is processed through Median Filter-Savitzky Golay Filter to minimize the noise from the data and determine the size at early stage. Then., from the filtered data., optimal attributes are extracted using Dense net and., in the end., SEN et is incorporated for classification and evaluated using various metrics. The proposed DenseN et169-SEN et acquired higher results with the accuracy of DenseNet169-SENet is 97.63%., Precision is 95.77%., Recall is 98.56%., F1 score is 96.44%. when compared with existing Convolution Neural Network (CNN).

Author Keywords: savitzky-golay filter and squeeze excitation network

articleTitle: Influence of Social Networks in the Digital Economy Using Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In response to the problems faced by traditional social network influence analysis methods such as complex network structure, limited data sources, and lack of flexibility in analysis models, this article used graph neural network technology to conduct more accurate social network influence analysis in the digital economy field. A social network graph was constructed from two aspects: data preparation and graph construction, and then the social relationship features of nodes were extracted. Then, Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) were used for training to learn the information transmission patterns between nodes. Finally, the influence score of the node was calculated to identify its users with significant influence. The results showed that the influence score of the model increased over time from 4, 8, 11, 15, 21, and 26, indicating the reliability of the model's performance. The research results provide reliable support for social network analysis in the digital economy.

articleTitle: Application of Android Based Mobile Learning Platform Using Latent Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, the growth of mobile learning systems has been remarkable, as it helps in transforming the educational landscape globally and emerged as a natural extension of Electronic Learning (E-learning). In previous, mobile learning platforms are used such as Java-based Mobile application for Mathematics Learning (JMML). However, the existing JMML has restricted generalizability and there is no automatic grading functionality. Hence, this paper presented an effective Android based Mobile Learning Platform Using Latent Semantic Analysis (AML-LSA) to provide automatic grading results. Initially, software architecture with client-server model and a web application server is implemented. Then, a database system to store files, a speech recognition system to recognize phrases, and a validator program to compile answer submission files. Finally, LSA is introduced to evaluate validation results and offers grading results to students and teachers based on the answer submission. From the results, the proposed AML-LSA model achieved outperforming results when compared to existing Smart Learning Media based on Android Technology (SLMAT) model by providing results in terms of mean score and Standard Deviation (SD) with 89.10% and 2.23 respectively.

articleTitle: Stock Market Trend Prediction Model Using Deep Learning Based Sentiment Analysis of Financial Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Creating a forecasting model to identify the trend in the stock market is difficult due to the complex nature and behavior of investors participating in the stock market. The existing models and studies have mainly used past prices and other technical indicators based on past prices or volume to predict future prices or trends instead of Behavioral finance for the Indian market. This study demonstrates a novel neural network-based stock market trend prediction model, which employs sentiment analysis data of published financial information. Deep learning-based sentiment analysis applications are used to identify investor sentiment based on published financial information on Macroeconomic and Microeconomic factors. The deep learning-based trend prediction model using sentiment analysis data has a more than 96% accuracy rate. The study also provides further evidence of behavioral finance theory of herd mentality in the Indian market. The result of research will benefit in the field of financial investment and risk management in the Indian stock market.

articleTitle: Optimization Design Method of Ventilation System Based on Fuzzy Logic in Industrial Ventilation Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Traditional design methods based on empirical formulas or deterministic models are difficult to effectively cope with the complexity and uncertainty of the factory production environment. In this paper, a fuzzy logic-based design method for industrial ventilation system optimization is proposed. The method first establishes a fuzzy optimization model containing objective functions such as ventilation effect, energy consumption and investment cost. Then the fuzzy optimization model is solved using a genetic algorithm to generate a set of potential optimal solutions. Finally, these solutions are comprehensively evaluated using fuzzy decision theory, and the optimal solution is selected as the final ventilation system design. The results of the study show that the start-up time is 10–18 minutes, which is 3–5 minutes faster than the previous system. The introduction of fuzzy logic also makes the method highly interpretable, providing engineers with clear decision support.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Logistics Scheduling by using Combined Ant Colony Optimization with Harmony Search
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, the logistic scheduling a vital component of the modern economy, playing a critical role in ensuring the seamless and efficient operation of the supply chain. The logistic scheduling requires efficient operation for timely goods delivery. However, it involves complex factors and route allocation optimization in logistics systems is a significant issue with the lack of convergence speed. Hence, this research proposes an intelligent logistics scheduling model based Ant-Colony Optimization and Harmony Search (ACO-HS) to improve the convergence speed by minimizing the transportation time. This process begins with the collection of supply chain logistics dataset from kaggle portal. Then, the data is preprocessed by using regression imputation, for predicting the missing values and logarithmic-scaling for transforming values into nonlinear space. After that, ACO and HS are utilized for recognizing the new schedule of supply chain logistics to obtain an efficient optimal route. As per the results, the proposed ACO-HS model achieved outstanding results in terms of transportation time, product damage, and customer satisfaction with 2 days, 9%, and 97% respectively, when compared to existing Adaptive Ant Colony Optimization for Dynamic Scheduling (AACA-DS) model.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Sport and Fitness Monitoring Based on Improved Quantum-Inspired Differential Evaluation with Dendritic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, the intelligent sports and fitness monitoring influences data analytics for producing the real-time perceptions into the performance of athlete and fitness, however it faces difficulties includes privacy concerns, data accuracy and incorporating with existing systems. In this research, Improved Quantum-inspired Differential Evaluation with Dendritic Neural Network (IQDE-DNN) is proposed to increase convergence speed. Initially data is collected from the hardware sensors such as gyroscope, skin temperature, optical heart rate and others sensors. Further data is pre-processed by utilizing the Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) to decompose the nonlinear and stationary signals from the time series to residuals. Then the initial weights and threshold values are generated by using the Quantum Inspired Differential Evolution optimization (IQDE) to increase the performance of the evaluation. Further Dendritic Neural Networks (DNN)is employed to evaluate the data from the soma layer as fitness and sport of an athlete. From the results, the proposed IQDE-DNN established better results when compared with existing Internet of Things based Cyber Physical systems of Physical Fitness Evaluation Method (IoT-CPS-PFEM) in terms of accuracy (95.4%), precision (90.3%), recall (92.1%) and F1-Score (90.1%) respectively.

articleTitle: Automatic Scoring Model for English Compositions Using Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer with Pearson Correlation Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, automatic scoring models are playing a crucial role in evaluating essays which have been utilized in the large-scale writing compositions. The existing models for the automatic scoring model for English compositions including Automatic Evaluation System (AES) suffered with contextual understanding. To overcome the issues, Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer with Pearson Correlation Coefficient (BERT -PCC) evaluation model is proposed in this research. The pre-trained BERT model improves the contextual understanding and enhances the semantic representation of the compositions. Initially, the input data is taken from the TOEFL11 dataset and further processed for preprocessing with various techniques including stop words, punctuations removal and lemmatization. After that, a pre-trained BERT model is employed to extract the features from preprocessed data with feature extraction layer from sequence, token and positional embedding's. At last, the PCC based evaluation model is introduced to evaluate the English compositions based on similarity of two variables with three manual scoring metrics. From the results, the proposed BERT-PCC model achieved better results in terms of score relevance of 0.60, average score error of 4.07 and average score accurate of 80.21% respectively when compared with existing Automatic Evaluation System (AES).

Author Keywords: automatic scoring model for english compositions

articleTitle: Evaluation of Sustainable Utilization of Urban Land Resources based on DensN et20 1 and Inception Version 3
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Recent days, urbanization is developed tremendously that providing economic growth and accesses to markets, entrepreneurship and industries. This Urban development leverages land resources in creating booming cities with diverse industries, institutions, and transportation infrastructure. As these constructions are increasing it is also very important to evaluate the urban land resources for flexible future generation's capability to happen their personal needs. The existing methods in evaluation failed in modeling temporary alteration in urban land use and development. Therefore, this paper proposes DensNet201-InceptionVersion 3 (V3) for efficient evaluation of sustain ability of urban land resources. The proposed method employed on deep globe land cover classification dataset that incorporates various land cover classes' satellite images. The collected image data is preprocessed using min max scaling for normalizing all images pixel values into similar ranges. This preprocessed data optimal features are extracted using DensNet201. The obtained relevant features are classified using Inception V3for evaluating the utilization of urban land resources are sustainable or not. The proposed DensNet201-InceptionV3 achieved better results in terms of accuracy of (99.82%), Specificity of (99.45%), Sensitivity of (99.73%), and Recall of (99.76%) when compared with existing Artificial Neural Network (ANN).

articleTitle: Analysis of Machine and Deep Learning-Based Approaches in Fetal Brain Abnormality Detection Using Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Background: Abnormalities in the brain are detected at an earlier stage using ultrasound imaging of fetuses. Some of the review works are explored only the old techniques that is not sufficient to detect the brain abnormality. Novelty of the survey: It aims to provide a deep comprehensive survey on fetal brain abnormality detection methods using deep learning and machine learning. Initially, the data acquisition of the fetal brain abnormality detection process is analyzed and the segmentation and feature extraction techniques utilized for the detection of fetal brain abnormalities are analyzed. Finally, the future scope of the fetal brain abnormality detection approaches using ultrasound images are discussed which may be helpful for the researchers to make further advancements. Findings: Most of the research works are explored with diverse performance measures. Instead, the accuracy of the Stack FBA and CNN model shows the accuracy of 97.27% among various research works.

articleTitle: Identification of Cattle's Breed Type by Processing Image Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Accurately identifying cattle breeds is crucial for effective livestock management and breeding. This research work uses advanced computer techniques to automatically recognize cattle breeds from images. It was used with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), which are good at detecting specific details in images to distinguish one breed from another. Before predicting, images are prepared and enhanced to ensure accurate results. The research work tests CNN models like DenseNet201, MobileNetV2, and Xception to determine which performs bettter. It measured performance using metrics like precision, recall, and F1 score. This automated approach provides farmers and breeders with a reliable tool to identify breeds and improve management. CNN technology helps modernize traditional farming methods, supporting sustainable livestock care. The study aims to find the most accurate CNN model for predicting cattle breeds, emphasizing the benefits of automated systems in maintaining breed purity, genetic diversity, and overall livestock health.

articleTitle: Short Wave Infrared Band Based Flood Classification Near the Garonne and Ohio River Basins
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Remote sensing images provides rich information over different wavelengths creating multispectral images capable of flood related applications. Visible bands in the multispectral images, namely, red, blue and green bands are certain times not sufficient enough to detect floods. Hence it is important to utilize Short-Wave Infrared (SWIR) bands due to their sensitivity to various surface materials and climatic factors. The results of flood classification using random forest in the bench-marking flood dataset demonstrates the importance of SWIR bands in addition to visible bands.

articleTitle: Dynamic Adaptive Weight Sparrow Search Algorithm for High-Strength Self-Consolidating Concrete Mix Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Concrete is the most used human-made material that has been utilized in the construction industry. Mix design optimization is difficult due to properties of concrete based on chemical and physical properties of the components as well as their relative proportions. Since number of parameters are comprised in a concrete mix design, identifying an optimal mixing design has always been a challenge for concrete engineers. Hence, this research proposes the Dynamic Adaptive Weighting Sparrow Search Algorithm (DAWSSA) approach for the High Strength Self-Consolidating Concrete mixt design (HSCC). This proposed methodology utilizes the data normalization and data partitioning techniques to normalize the data for enhancing the performance. Then, Best-Worst Method (BWM) approach is accomplished for pairwise comparisons of the quality criteria. The effectiveness of the proposed DAWSSA is estimated by utilizing various error metrices like R-Square (R2), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of values about 0.86, 1.57 and 2.29 respectively when compared to the previous works such as Multi-objective Salp Swarm Algorithm (MOSSA) and SSA-Extreme Gradient Boosting (SSA-XGB).

Author Keywords: dynamic adaptive weighting sparrow search algorithm and high strength self-consolidating concrete mixt design

articleTitle: Competency Analysis System for Higher Vocational Art and Design Teachers Based on Collaborative Filtering with K-Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the recent days, the sector of higher vocational education in art and design needs highly skilled teachers with specific competencies to prepare students efficiently. Previous researches have suggested various effective methods but still there are challenges such as recognizing and standardizing key performance indicators that align with higher vocational teaching demands while enabling adaptive feedback for teachers' continuous improvement. This study aims to design and construct a competency analysis system for higher vocational art and design teachers using deep learning to effectively capture complex teaching abilities through large-scale data analysis. Initially the data is collected from Teaching and Learning International Survey (TALIS). Then, the collected data is preprocessed using data standardization and tokenization. The processed data is further fed into feature extraction model namely, Robustly optimized Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (RoBERT) since it can effective extracts the optimal attributes and assist for analysis. In the end, Collaborative filtering with K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) is utilized for recommendation model and analyzed using the evaluation metrics such as accuracy, recall, precision and fl-score. The proposed model is compared with various conventional methods namely BERT and resulted in higher accuracy of 98.67%.

Author Keywords: competency analysis system for higher vocational art and design teachers
robustly optimized bidirectional encoder representations from transformers

articleTitle: Embedding's from Language Model with Chi Square Test based Smart City Construction Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, cities are attempting to categorize as smart worldwide but classifying truly is becoming a great challenge. The existing methods including Adversarial Neural Network (ANN) for the evaluation of smart city construction mainly suffered with overfitting. In this paper, Embedding's from Language Model with Chi square test (ELMo-Chi Square test) method is proposed. The ELMo feature extraction model is utilized to reduce the overfitting issue of the training model. Initially, the input data is taken from smart portal and then preprocessed with the help of various techniques such as reducing stop words, lemmatization, stemming and data cleaning. After that, the features are extracted with ELMo and then Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) selects the optimal features such as buildings, roads, streetlights, water management. Finally, the Chi-Square Test is exploited to evaluate the values of extracted data in a sequence. Therefore, the evaluation of smart city construction is performed effectively through proposed ELMo-Chi-Square test model. From the results, the proposed ELMo-Chi Square test established better results in terms of accuracy (0.98), recall (0.96), precision (0.97), and Fl-score (0.97) respectively when compared with Artificial Neural Network (ANN).

articleTitle: Fruits and Vegetables Disease Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Fruits and vegetables play a crucial role in maintaining overall health, offering essential nutrients and numerous health benefits. Advancements in computer vision technology have simplified various agriculture-related issues, including the detection of fruit and vegetable diseases. In this research, we introduce a deep learning-driven system for classifying the disease of grapes, guavas, pomegranates, cucumbers, potatoes, and tomatoes as healthy or rotten. ResNet50 achieved the highest accuracy at 98%, with MobileNetV2 following closely at 89%, Xception at 66%, and InceptionV3 at 62%. Our methodology involves comprehensive image acquisition, pre-processing, and segmentation techniques to enhance feature extraction. This system enables farmers to effectively identify and separate healthy produce from rotten ones, ensuring better crop management and reduced waste. Our findings highlight the potential of CNNs in agricultural applications, providing a robust solution for maintaining crop quality and supporting sustainable farming practices. Future research directions are also discussed to further refine these techniques.

articleTitle: Design of Online Translation Language System based on Android System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Cross-Ianguage communication is very important for people from different countries. While existing translation systems have some advantages, they have shortcomings such as low translation accuracy and slow translation efficiency. To provide users with convenient translation services, this study proposes an online translation voice system based on the Android system. The system design and function implementation are introduced. Based on Android platform features and functions, a user-friendly interface is designed allowing multiple functions such as text translation, voice translation (speech-to-speech), and image translation. The research results show that the system's translation success rate is as high as 96.2%. The system is significantly improved in translation success rate, accuracy and speed. Users can quickly obtain accurate, contextually coherent and natural language use by inputting text or voice translation speech. The real-time features of the system allow for its use in various environments such as real-time conversation, travel, and business. This research provides a useful reference for the design of an online translation language system based on the Android system; and moreover, provides students with easy, accurate and fast translation services.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Prediction of Hydraulic Systems Based on Bi Directional Recurrent Neural Network With Attention Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Since years, hydraulic systems play vital role in modern industry, but failures result in substantial economic losses and downtime. Traditional approaches for fault diagnosis and prediction of hydraulic system had faced several challenges which include sensitive to noise, lack of temporal understanding and linearity assumption. Therefore, this research proposes Bi-directional Recurrent Neural Network- Attention Long Short-Term Memory (BRNN-ALSTM) for Fault diagnosis and prediction of hydraulic systems. Initially, the data is taken from condition monitoring of hydraulic systems dataset which consists of data collected from sensors like pressure, flow rate, temperature and vibration measurements of various sensors installed in hydraulic system. This data is preprocessed by using z-score normalization which enhanced the predictive capability and facilitated the model's optimization. Then, pre-processed data optimal features are selected by utilizing variational autoencoder that efficiently eliminated irrelevant attributes from the sensors data. The selected optimal features are classified by employed BRNN for diagnosing the faults in hydraulic system which effectively captured temporal dependencies and patterns in data and finally ALSTM is employed for predicting the faults. The proposed BRNN-ALSTM achieved better accuracy of 99.67% when compared with existing Multi Sensor Convolution Neural Network (MSCNN).

articleTitle: Innovative Multislot Wearable Antenna for Enhanced Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and performance analysis of a multislot wearable antenna for early breast cancer detection. Operating at a frequency of 2.69 GHz, the antenna uses Teflon as the dielectric substrate. The design incorporates multiple slots and is evaluated using the ANSYS HFSS simulator. A rectangular feed line energizes a rectangular radiating patch, resulting in a compact design measuring 72 mm x 61 mm x 3.5 mm. This design features an innovative inset feed approach and a full ground plane, which improves impedance matching and extends the operational bandwidth. The proposed antenna demonstrates an exceptional return loss of -26.0527 dB, indicating minimal signal reflection and efficient power transfer. Additionally, the antenna achieves a voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of 1.1118, signifying near-perfect impedance matching across the operational band. Its outstanding impedance value of 49.8384 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Omega$</tex> at the resonance frequency, further underscores the antenna's efficient power handling capabilities.

articleTitle: English Learning Knowledge Point Recommendation Algorithm based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, personalized learning has become very important in educational sector for recommending knowledge points to individual learning needs adaptive systems that enhance learning efficiency and engagement drives the exploration. Many researchers have suggested various models for English learning using static models but failed to resolve existing challenges such as beginning, with limited empirical indication representing its effectiveness in English learning contexts. This study contributes by incorporating innovative Reinforcement Learning (RL) to continuously improve its recommendations based on learner feedback, making it highly responsive and personalized. The RL based knowledge recommendation framework for English learning specifically Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) with Knowledge Point Recommendation (KPR) algorithm. Initially, Coursera is employed for dataset and then data text cleaning, tokenization, padding is incorporated in pre-processing to convert the unstructured data to labeled data. Further, the features are selected through Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) to eliminate unrelated features, decrease complexity and increases the model's capability to simplify to hidden data. Finally, the developed DDPG-KPR model was measured using accuracy of 97.89%. Hence, the proposed RL recommendation model provides higher accuracy value when compared to Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM).

articleTitle: Traffic Congestion Prediction and Mitigation Strategies Combined with Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Traditional traffic flow prediction models have limitations in dealing with complex road network structures and dynamically changing traffic flows, and cannot fully capture the spatial and temporal correlation characteristics of traffic flow. Therefore, this article explores a new method for predicting traffic flow on urban main roads, which combines a local sensitive discriminant analysis model and an improved deep learning structure. Firstly, based on the local sensitivity discriminant analysis model, the feature extraction of the similarity matrix of the urban main road traffic network is studied, and high-dimensional traffic data is mapped to a low dimensional manifold to achieve effective extraction of traffic features. Subsequently, a deep learning model combining spatiotemporal graph convolution and improved Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) is developed, which improves the accuracy of traffic flow prediction by analyzing the spatiotemporal correlation of upstream and downstream traffic data. The experimental results show that this method exhibits high prediction accuracy under different traffic conditions and can effectively capture the dynamic trends of urban traffic flow. The research results of this article provide strong support for the design and optimization of intelligent transportation systems. As the training period increases, the accuracy of the training set gradually improves, increasing from 75.2% to 84.7%, indicating that the training performance of the model continues to improve.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Compressive Strength in Coconut Shell-Embedded Concrete Using Ensemble Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This study is based on the exploration of ensemble regression models using Adaboost Regressor, Random Forest Regressor, Gradient Boosting Regressor, and XGBoost Regressor for predicting the compressive strength of coconut shell concrete. In the study normalization technique, and 5-fold cross-validation for the training and testing of the models over a dataset of 483 samples are employed, constituting various concrete mix features. It produced the result showing competitive performance with the top performance being Adaboost Regressor that resulted in a score of 0.81 R2 and a minimal MSE of 1.16. With the help of SHAP, it has been analyzed and observed that influential pivotal effects have been outlined by influential features including Age, Coarse Aggregate, and Water content in the predictions. Age of concrete has emerged highest important factor that puts it in a leading role for determining compressive strength. The research itself gives insight into the optimal formulation of concrete, harmonizing between structural integrity and sustainability. Ensemble models, coupled with SHAP, give inspiring directions for advancing concrete technology in eco-friendly construction practices.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Different Machine Learning Approaches for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Crop yield prediction plays a pivotal role in agricultural planning and decision-making, influencing farmers, policymakers, and supply chain stakeholders. This paper conducts a comparative analysis of machine learning techniques for crop yield forecasting, emphasizing the accuracy, resilience, and adaptability of each approach to varying crop types and environmental conditions. A novel integration of machine learning and grid search hyperparameter optimization is proposed, utilizing an extensive historical dataset. Key algorithms, including Random Forest and Support Vector Machines, are applied, with rigorous data preprocessing to address missing values and outliers. Through evaluation metrics like Mean Absolute Error and R-squared, we assess model effectiveness, with Random Forest emerging as the top performer. This study's contributions lie in enhancing predictive accuracy and providing actionable insights for precision agriculture. Experiment result shows that Random Forest and XGBoost regressors stand out as strong performers for this dataset, with the Random Forest model achieving the highest score of 97%.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Optimizing Network Performance in $\kappa-\mu$ Fading and Co-Channel Interference Environments using Machine Learning and Experimental Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: ML and RL are one of the innovative solutions to optimize network performance in K-J.1 fading and co-channel interference scenarios where traditional methods often fail. ML employs data driven, adaptive methods to minimize signal degradation and interference while significantly enhancing throughput, SNR (signal-to-noise ratio) and overall system performance. The manner in which the transmission power and the antenna configuration should be set can be indeed determined by factorial experiments (FEs) additionally to RSM [together with what it is called, response surface methodology. RL algorithms make use of the RL for dynamic parameter updates and maximize cumulative rewards at each time-step. My main takeaway from this work is that machine learning can be used to facilitate reliable and efficient communication in challenging wireless environments, which could be applicable beyond the setting considered here. Additional insights into scalability will be needed to generalize ML-driven optimization across different network scenarios.

articleTitle: Harnessing RNN for Enhanced Hate Speech Detection in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Social media offers a platform for both conversation and hate speech, making effective detection mechanisms necessary. This paper proposes a deep learning framework using RNN for hate speech detection on Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook. Key findings show that the RNN-based model outperforms LSTM and GRU models, achieving accuracies of 96.75% on Twitter, 95.3% on Instagram, and 98.20% on Facebook. These results demonstrate that RNNs better capture contextual relationships within text compared to traditional methods, while also emphasizing the need for specialized techniques in detecting hate speech across platforms. The pro- posed model holds significant potential for enhancing online safety through efficient hate speech recognition. The analysis confirms RNNs' superior accuracy for platform-specific hate speech detection, offering a powerful tool for improving detection strategies and online safety.

articleTitle: A Coupling - Patterned Microstrip Patch Antenna for X-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this new era of wireless communication technology, the design and analysis of microstrip patch antennas for X-band applications, which connects billions of people and machines for radar and satellite applications, is a pervasive practice. The proposed antenna measures 24mm by 18mm and consists of a 1.57mm thick FR4 substrate. The substrate's dielectric constant is 0.0009, and its relative permittivity is 2.2. A 50-microstrip line delivers the excitation. The evaluation and simulation of the antenna's performance took place using ADS 2020. The X-band applications operate over a frequency range of about 8 to 11 GHz, where the return loss is -10 dB. Its emission pattern is consistent, ranging from 5.28 dBi, providing an average gain that is more prominent and highly suitable for X- band satellite applications.

articleTitle: An Artificial Neural Networks with Particle Swarm Optimization using ReliefF for Construction Cost Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: N ow a days, construction cost evaluation is a dynamic process in project management which enables accurate estimation by analysis and controlling of costs to guarantee projects are completed efficiently, within budget, and to desired quality standards. Blasting is a crucial aspect of the construction and mining industries. However, blast designers face a persistent challenge of minimizing the adverse effects of explosive usage on surrounding areas, particularly flyrock and ground vibration which has unintended consequences on the environment and nearby structure. To overcome these issues Artificial Neural N etworks-Particle Swarm Optimization (ANN-PSO) is proposed by collecting the input from the Construction Spending dataset. The ReliefF algorithm selects relevant features from the dataset, which are then used as input for classification. The proposed method hybridizes ANN-PSO classification improve accuracy and efficiency of the construction cost evaluation. The ensemble method leverages the strengths of both techniques, providing a robust approach for classification and prediction in construction spending. The proposed ANN-PSO produce more results than traditional methods of Particle Swarm Optimization Deep Neural Networks (PSO-DNN) for modeling extreme values such as R2 and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) with the values of (0.003) and (0.067) respectively.

articleTitle: Self-Organized Graph Neural Network with Adaptive Boosting Support Vector Regression Prediction Model for Smart Traffic Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Advancement in technology has led path for automated road traffic management software in order to minimize the road traffic. The prediction of road traffic helps to maintain the harmony in the society. The existing model failed to predict appropriate road traffic due to lack of data preprocess and feature extraction ability that affected the smart traffic management system. To Self-Organized Graph Neural Network with Adaptive Boosting Support Vector Regression (SOGNN-ABSVR) is proposed for the smart traffic management. The z-score normalization technique was used to normalize the ranges of the data that increased the model training. The Self-Organized Graph Neural Network (SOGNN) extracted the spatial and temporal features from the road network data. The Adaptive Boosting Support Vector Regression (ABSVR) classifier was used to predict the traffic network. The proposed SOGNN-ABSVR method performance was evaluated in terms of Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) performance parameters and has obtained greater results having RMSE of 4.97 for NYC dataset and 2.14 for PeMS-Bay datasets respectively compared to the existing Multi-Component Attention Graph Convolutional Network (MCAGCN) method.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Resource Library for Japanese Language Teaching Based on Gated Recurrent Unit with Secure Shell Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, the application of digital resource library for Japanese language teaching is becoming a demand for online language learning, which is user to overcome the traditional limitations of traditional teaching. However, the traditional teaching mainly undergoes with limited resource access and lack of interaction. Therefore, in this research, Gated Recurrent Unit based Secure Shell framework (GRU-SSH) model is proposed. This application provides the security to the digital resources in front-end with various SSH frameworks. The SSH frameworks includes struts framework which is utilized to provide security with spring dependencies. Then, the spring framework works with lesson planning's, interactive exercises and courses management. After that, hibernate framework interacts with the database to return the Japanese language to the spring services. In back-end, for model training the input data is taken from llmjapanese dataset and further preprocessed with various techniques. Then, the course recommendations are generated with the help of GRU model for the effective generation of Japanese language teachings to students. From the results, the proposed GRU-SSH model gave better results when compared to existing Long Short Term Memory by providing results in terms of accuracy of (95.28%), precision of (92.78%), recall of (91.86%) and F1-score of (93.15%) respectively.

Author Keywords: digital resource library for japanese language teaching

articleTitle: Educational Big Data Mining and Analysis Based on Support Vector Machine Performance Prediction Rate
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this era, educational data has generated data-driven insights, especially with the application of machine learning models to predict the student performance. Even though previous researchers suggested various robust machines learning techniques still there are several challenges such as data complexity, privacy concerns, and the varied formats of educational data for efficient data processing and analysis. This study focuses on developing a robust model for predicting student performance by employing advanced machine learning methods tailored for educational data. This paper proposes a novel approach namely GIWRF-SVM utilizing Gini Impurity based Weighted Random Forest (GIWRF) with Support Vector Machine (SVM) performance prediction rate. Initially, the data is collected from Academic Performance Dataset (xAPI-Edu-Data) i.e. XAPI dataset. Then, the collected data is processed using various techniques such as discretization and resampling. Further, the processed data is fed as input to Gini Impurity based Weighted Random Forest (GIWRF) for feature selection. In the end, SVM is used for prediction of academic warning for college student's has acquired greater results with Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 9.24, Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 4.28 and Root Absolute Error (RAE) of 4.76 when compared with Genetic Algorithm with Decision Tree Regression.

Author Keywords: gini impurity based weighted random forest
prediction rate and support vector machine

articleTitle: Gated Recurrent Unit and ResNet-50 with Gaussian Naïve Bayes Algorithm Based Infectious Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The early detection of infectious disease helps to minimize the spreading of disease with the surrounding environment. Advancement in technology has given automated software for the recognition of infectious disease. The existing methods did not obtain appropriate results for the early detection of infectious disease due to lack of handling the feature dimensionalities. To solve the problem of the existing methods a Gated Recurrent Unit and ResNet-50 with Naive Bayes (GRU and ResNet-50 with NB) is proposed for the infectious disease detection. The chest x-ray dataset is the input data, the normalization and augmentation techniques were used for cleaning the chest x-ray images. The Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) was used for the taking out of temporal information from the images and further the ResNet-50 extracted the spatial information from chest x-ray image data. The Naive Bayes (NB) is the classifier used for the infectious disease detection. The developed GRU and ResNet-50 with NB has increased the performance of infectious disease detection. The performance of the proposed GRU and ResNet-50 with NB is assessed using the existing metrics such as accuracy 97.89%, recall 97.05%, precision 96.92%, and fl-score 96.98% compared to the existing eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) method.

articleTitle: Physics Teaching System Based on Three Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network with Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this era, physics teaching system is required to visualize and comprehend various concepts such as energy conservation, collisions, and momentum transfer that need dynamic and interactive environments to bridge the gap between theoretical principles and real-world applications. The integration of three dimensional (3D) Virtual Reality (VR) technology helps to overcome the issue of computational complexity. The motive of this paper is to develop a system for effective teaching of physics using VR by categorizing the inherited data into three types based on collisions; elastic collision, inelastic collision and Complex systems like multiple object collisions. Initially, the data is inherited from the PhysX cohort that contains various physics related data such as collisions, dynamics and other physics phenomena. The collected data is processed through Bounding Volume Hierarchies (BVH) and Separating Axis Theorem (SAT). Further, the processed data is embedded into 3D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model since it has the ability to extract optimal spatial features. In the end, the extracted features are translated into VR model using robust tools such as Unity and NVIDIA. The proposed 3DCNN-VR model achieves greater results with accuracy of 98.68% when compared with Immersive VR (IVR).

articleTitle: Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on HO-VMD and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to discuss a series of problems in traditional methods, such as the nonlinearity and non-smoothness of the vibration signal of a rolling bearing, inaccurate extraction of fault features, and poor generalization ability when it faces a large dataset. It proposes a fault diagnostic model based on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) along with a Hippopotamus Optimization Algorithm (HO) optimized Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD) method. In this paper, the Hippopotamus Optimization Algorithm was adopted to optimize mode number (k) and regularization coefficient (a) of the VMD for enhancing accuracy and improving efficiency, in order to make variational modal decomposition adapt to needs of different signal processing better. Then, the extracted vibration signals are decomposed into a series of intrinsic mode functions by using VMD and selecting optimal mode components according to the minimum envelope entropy principle. This last step includes sets of sample features that feed into the Convolutional Neural Network, which will identify the types of faults. In this paper, compared with the traditional VMD-CNN fault diagnosis model, the VMD-CNN model optimized by Hippopotamus Optimization Algorithm was used, and then, it can be found that the prediction accuracy of this method reaches 97.4 % and 95.3% on the training set and the test set, respectively, which are well higher than that of the traditional VMD-CNN fault diagnosis model.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Electrical Control System based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: As a fundamental part of intelligent apparatus, the fault diagnosis of electrical control systems is very imperative, since this traj ectory of diagnosis aims at improving reliability and safety of the system. Traditional genetic algorithms have been utilized extensively for fault diagnosis; their limitations, though, lie in accuracy and real-time performance. Therefore, this paper provides an attempt at a better method of the fault diagnosis of electrical control systems employing Genetic Algorithms. The algorithm includes innovative lock-up of genetic operations, peer-based feature extraction, and multi-obj ective optimization, hence augmenting the performance of such a diagnosis. From experimental results, the overall recognition accuracy of diagnosis by the improved genetic algorithm exceeds 97.8% average recognition rate after running five different typical fault modes, with a maximum accuracy value of 99%, thus outperforming its closest competing algorithm by a margin of nearly 8.6%. Moreover, the algorithm flies in the face of the competition in terms of time taken for diagnosis, now only requiring 2.26 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s$</tex> on average-again, almost precisely half of that taken by the traditional method.
