Thus, the proposed algorithm does not only enhance accuracy in fault recognition, but it is also more efficient and represents a useful tool for ensuring reliability and safety in electrical control systems.

articleTitle: An Effective Forest Fire Prediction Based on Contrastive Vision Transformer with Pool Former
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Since years, forest fires are a significant concern globally, causing damage to ecosystems and human settlements. For effective prevention and mitigation predicting forest fires is important, different factors contribute to forest fires which includes human activities, topography, climate change and weather conditions. Traditional approaches for predicting forest fires had faced significant challenges which include limited validation of prediction models and lack of standardization. Therefore, this paper proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CViT)-Pool Former for predicting forest fire which is employed on Forest Fire Big Data dataset which enabled better comparability. This dataset is preprocessed by using data augmentation, noise reduction and data enhancement techniques. Then, the features are extracted by using CViT which extracted optimal features based on weather conditions and captured contextual relationships by maximizing mutual information. After that, Pool Former light weight attention module is used for predicting fires which gave more accurate predictions by enabling targeted prevention and mitigation, minimized unwanted deployments and resource waste, boosted prediction accuracy by token fusion and enhanced representation learning. The proposed CViT-Pool Former method established better results including accuracy (92.8%), precision (89.4%), recall (91.4%) and F1-score (90.2%) when compared with existing Region Proposed Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN).

articleTitle: An Interpretable Approach with Explainable AI for the Detection of Cardiovascular Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is one of the prominent contributors to global mortality. Early detection and precise diagnosis of the disease are critically required to reduce its impact. This paper proposes an interpretable approach using Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) to detect cardiovascular disease. By combining different machine learning (ML) algorithms with XAI techniques, we aim to enhance the models' predictability and transparency. Further, we use SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to provide a human-understandable explanation of model predictions. The proposed approach emphasizes both the accuracy and interpretability of the model which enhances the model's performance and also solves the black-box problem associated with AI models. Our results demonstrate that the proposed models achieve competitive performance metrics, where ANN achieved the highest accuracy of 91%. This work highlights the importance of XAI to bridge the gap between ML models and clinical decision-making, fostering trust in AI-driven healthcare solutions for the early detection of cardiovascular disease.

articleTitle: The Construction of Translation Memory and Terminology Database Using Deep Learning and XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Machine translation quality can be significantly enhanced by integrating external information into the translation process. Unlike traditional generative approaches, using external information enables models to access additional data during training, reducing reliance on limited training datasets. Three fusion methods are primarily utilized in this context: those based on bilingual dictionaries, translation memories, and templates. This study investigates techniques for incorporating external information, specifically through the construction of a translation memory and terminology database. The translation memory is optimized using deep learning methods and the XGBoost (eXtreme Gradient Boosting) algorithm. A comparative analysis evaluates the performance of both algorithms on translation accuracy and efficiency. Experimental findings reveal that, with only 10 hours of training on 5,000 data entries, the XGBoost algorithm achieves an 88.5% accuracy rate and covers 75% of the terminology database, demonstrating its advantage in large-scale data processing and predictive tasks. These findings highlight the importance of selecting appropriate algorithms to maximize translation memory applications, offering technical insights to further improve machine translation efficacy.

articleTitle: A Multi-Layer Perceptron with Logistic Regression Based on Residual Networks for Martial Arts Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, Martial arts embody a dynamic fusion of physical discipline, mental toughness, personal development, community, and cultural heritage to cultivate a holistic approach to well-being and modern living. Precise identification of martial arts techniques is essential to ensure safety, optimize performance, and foster personal growth, whereas inaccurate recognition can spread harm, aggression, and cultural misconceptions. Various methods have been proposed previously to recognize the actions of martial arts. To overcome these problems, a Multi-Layer Perceptron with Logistic Regression (MLP-LR) is proposed to recognize the actions of martial arts. At inception, an Ultimate Fighting Championship/Mixed Martial Arts Fights Image Segmentation (U/M-FIS) dataset is considered as an input for recognizing martial arts actions. For preprocessing, image resizing, image normalization, data augmentation, noise reduction, and contrast enhancement are employed. Residual Network 50 (ResN et50) is considered for feature extraction to reduce feature dimensionality, and to enhance robustness to noise and variability. Next, data preparation is done with training, testing, and pattern validation which is followed by classification using MLP-LR. The proposed MLP-LR model attained higher performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score of 99.96%, 99.87%, 99.52%, and 99.47%, when compared to other existing methods like Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

articleTitle: Simplex Social Spider Optimization with Decision Tree Consumer Behavior Patterns
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The population growth and the economic development are growing rapidly as a result of this makes more understanding the population behavior towards buying things. Understanding consumer behavior plays a major role for businesses in order to enhance the product quality and to provide a satisfactory product for consumers. The consumer behavior is considered in various factors based on age, their income, and their previous purchase history b considering all this factors a chart known as Customer Relationship Management (CRM) is made in order to maintain all the details of the customers of that particular company. In this study we proposed Simplex Social Spider Optimization (SSSO)-Decision Tree of the consumer behavior. This technique uses each customer information as a spider web and splits the data based on the feature values. The results indicated that specific features, such as purchase frequency, average transaction value, and product preferences, significantly influenced customer classification outcomes. A decision tree is used for the classification of the consumer behavior. This enhances the predicting and classifying the customer's attitude while purchasing the products. This research highlights the potential of predictive analytics in tailoring marketing strategies and improving CRM. The proposed method have achieved the accuracy of 92.42 % The findings suggest that businesses can leverage these insights to optimize targeted promotions and enhance customer experience, ultimately driving sales and fostering brand loyalty.

Author Keywords: simplex method based social spider optimization

articleTitle: Graph Neural Network Model Under Multi-Modal Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the real world, data usually exhibits multimodal characteristics with different sources and formats. Traditional unimodal processing methods often fail to fully utilize the correlation and complementary information between different modalities. In this paper, we integrate various modal data into a graph neural network framework to effectively learn and analyze the complex relationships between nodes and edges. Through the techniques of feature fusion, decision fusion and deep fusion, multimodal data can be comprehensively analyzed to extract more meaningful insights. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the method, and the classification accuracy is significantly improved, reaching up to 98 %. The recall rate reaches 86.9% and the F1 score is 0.964. These metrics highlight the strong performance that the model shows in complex, realistic scenarios dealing with multimodal data. The model shows significant potential in handling multimodal data, providing a robust and efficient method for complex data analysis. This demonstrates that in the real world, utilizing the rich information of multimodal data can lead to deeper insights and superior performance.

articleTitle: Online State Monitoring of Distribution Cable Faults Based Empirical Mode Decomposition with Convolutional Neural Network and Spiking Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, composited distribution cable terminals are important component of supplying power, which is extensively used in traction power supply systems. Traditional approaches for online state monitoring of distribution cable faults had faced several challenges which include more noise in data and contains only time domain features which is difficult to monitor cable faults. Therefore, this paper proposes Empirical Mode Decomposition-Convolutional Neural Network-Spiking Neural Network (EMD-CNN-SNN) for online state monitoring of distribution cable faults which is employed on electric fault line detection dataset, available in Kaggle. This dataset provides real time monitored three phase current signals and fault related parameters of distribution cables. The data is taken and preprocessed by using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) which is used to renovate time domain signals into frequency domain signals. Then, these preprocessed signals i.e. optimal features were selected by using EMD-CNN which is suitable for real time data, robust to noise and interference in signals. Finally, SSN is used for classification of optimal features and effectively diagnosed the distribution cable faults. The proposed EMD-CNN-SNN achieved accuracy and precision of (99.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and (98.3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) when compared with existing models like Artificial Neural Networks-Support Vector Machine (ANN-SVM).

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Tobacco Packaging Machine Detection using You Only Look Once Version 8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, the fault diagnosis of tobacco packaging machines is essential to certify the production efficiency, product quality, and reducing interruption in industrial settings. These machines are complex, involving various organized components functioning under high-speed and high-precision conditions, making fault detection and diagnosis a challenging task. Conventional diagnostic methods depend on human intervention and there are challenges such as choosing the suitable network architecture, handling imbalanced fault data, and assuring real-time implication performance remain substantial. This research paper suggests a novel approach by employing robust techniques for fault diagnosis of tobacco packaging machine to detect the quality of the tobacco packaging by accumulating data from the Carton Packing Tape (CPT) dataset. The collected data is preprocessed using an effective technique namely data augmentation, histogram equalization and the Squeeze and Excitation Residual Network (SE-ResNet) is employed to extract features from the embedded data. The extracted images are further classified using the You Only Look Once version 8 (YOLOv8) model. The proposed approach resulted with the F1-score of 94.77%, Precision of 98.56% and Recall of 94.04% when compared to YOLOv7.

articleTitle: Innovative Approaches to Cardiovascular Disease: Machine Learning Predictions Unveiled & Interpretation Using LIME & SHAP
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This study investigates how machine learning classification could revolutionize the field of cardiovascular disease prediction. By utilizing a variety of datasets that include demographic, lifestyle, and clinical information, several algorithms such as Logistic Regression, KNN, SVM, Decision Tree Classifier, GradientBoost, AdaBoost, XGBoost, Hyperparameter tuning, LIME and SHAP are used to create prediction models. The research hopes to facilitate early interventions and preventative measures by improving individualized risk assessments and their accuracy. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of ML in predicting cardiovascular risks, indicating a paradigm change in the direction of preventive healthcare. With further development, incorporating these models into clinical practice may be able to reduce the prevalence of cardiovascular illnesses worldwide by implementing timely and focused therapies.

articleTitle: An Efficient English Translation Practice Teaching System Using Gated Recurrent Unit with Attention Based Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, as global communication intensifies English Translation Practice Teaching (ETPT) nurtures, cultural understanding, language mastery, and connectivity, preparing entities for productive association and exchange in multilingual environments. To enhance ETPT, many methods has been proposed earlier, which has overfitting, generalizability, and complexity problems. To overcome these problems, a model name called Gated Recurrent Unit with Attention based Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (GRU-Attention based Bi-LSTM) is proposed. A TED Talks Translation (TED-TT) dataset is considered for high quality translation. For preprocessing, tokenization, Part-Of-Speech (POS) tagging, named entity recognition, dependency parsing, stop-word removal, and stemming/lemmatization were considered. Word2Vec embedding is taken as feature extraction to handle out-of-vocabulary words, to reduce noise and outliers, and to increase generalizability. A five-fold cross-validation is considered and performed to handle imbalanced data, and to gain accurate performance. The classification involves transformer encoder with Bi-directional Encoder Representation Transformers (BERT) to handle sequential data and GRU-Attention based Bi-LSTM as classifier to handle long-term dependencies, to improve translation accuracy, and to reduce overfitting. The proposed GRU-Attention based Bi-LSTM model obtained higher performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and f1 score with 97.92%, 98.67%, 96.34%, and 94.86% when compared to existing Recurrent Neural Network (RNN).

articleTitle: Development of an Efficient Algorithm for Acquisition of GNSS Receiver Signals Using Parallel Code Phase Search Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Recent advances in GNSS technology make it possible to apply this technology with radio occultation and precise orbit determination purposes, among many other applications. This paper presents an optimized GNSS acquisition algorithm. It allows detecting efficiently the visible satellites that reach the carrier frequency and code phase with consideration of Doppler shifts. More importantly, the algorithm uses a Parallel Code Phase Search technique that involves circular correlation within the frequency domain for far reaching simplification in terms of computation. Furthermore, since it is implemented in MATLAB, along with one-on-one comparison through Verilog HDL implementations, the approach generates Pseudo-Random Noise (PRN) codes, conducts Fast Fourier Transforms (DFT), and then cross-correlates to ensure signal detection. The algorithm has been found to be effective and flexible. This was tested on synthesized datasets, where search combinations reduced from 41,943 to 41. Therefore, it is effective and diversified in real-time signal acquisition.

articleTitle: A Mixed Arima and Grey Relational Analysis Model for Predicting Urban Traffic Congestion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Transportation is pivotal to urban development, playing an important role in economic expansion and cultural exchange. However, the design of current smart city transportation platforms is ineffective in predicting traffic congestion states. Traditional forecasting models, while able to achieve current predictive goals and tasks, lack relevance and completeness in practical applications, leading to errors in traffic congestion state predictions due to external environmental influences and specific factors. Additionally, the inefficiency of single-structured traffic congestion state predictions makes it difficult to accurately determine the prediction range, which introduces uncontrollable obstacles to the implementation of subsequent work. To address these issues, this study proposes a hybrid model that combines ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) and gray correlation analysis for urban traffic congestion prediction. This model integrates time series analysis with gray system theory to improve the accuracy and reliability of forecasting. Experimental results demonstrate that the hybrid model has high accuracy in capturing the changing trends of traffic flow, with an actual traffic flow of 520 vehicles/hour at 8 a.m. and a predicted flow of 510 vehicles/hour, resulting in a minimal error of 10 vehicles/hour. These findings provide reliable decision-making support for urban traffic management and help alleviate urban traffic congestion problems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Insider Threat Detection with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Insider threats pose significant risks to organizations by compromising sensitive data and resources. Detecting these threats effectively necessitates robust machine learning (ML) techniques capable of managing complex and imbalanced datasets. This paper explores the performance of various ML models, including Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, SVM, KNN, Naive Bayes, Adaboost, and XGBoost, using the widely recognized CERT dataset. By addressing data imbalance challenges through techniques such as SMOTE, the importance of a balanced dataset is highlighted. The results demonstrated that Random Forest and Adaboost achieved the highest accuracy of 97.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, underscoring their effectiveness in insider threat detection. This research contributes to enhancing insider threat detection methodologies and provides a structured analysis of model performance, paving the way for more reliable organizational security strategies.

articleTitle: An Effective Ideological and Political Course Learning System Based on Spring and Vaadin Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, the universities have developed various management systems to improve the efficiency, but managing student information, ideological and political courses remains complex due to the large volume of students and data. The existing Java Enterprise Edition (JavaEE) framework is utilized, but it has technical issues with the platform and required significant resources to implement. Hence, this research proposes Spring-Vaadin framework to build an application of ideological and political education learning system. Initially, the data is gathered from ideological and political dataset and preprocessed with an application. This application incorporates three layers namely Presentation Layer (PL), as it provides seamless User Interface (UI) through five primary views. Then, Business Logic Layer (BLL) comprises CourseService and UserService to validate the input data by handling user operations. Finally, the Data Access Layer (DAL) executes queries and manages database access, by providing a flexible interface and decoupling the application logic with the help of Relational Database Management System (RDBMS). As per the results, the proposed spring-vaadin framework provided outstanding results in accuracy 0.983, precision 0.972, Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) 0.459 and Mean Square Error (MAE) 1.027 respectively when compared with existing Neural Network based Ideological and Political Education (NN-IPE) model.

Author Keywords: ideological and political course learning system

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Efficient and Accurate Image Forgery Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Visuals are at the heart of information dissemination, especially on social platforms, but their credibility is not easy to ascertain because of their manipulability. Most of the forgery detection research done is mostly tailored to only a certain type of forgery and this limits its applicability in real life scenarios. The purpose of this study is to explore the use of transfer learning techniques of deep learning in improving the detection of forgeries. It is Iso used for finding the differences in compression quality in pre-trained models by generating features from them. The method tests eight models for binary classification, and MobileNetV2 has the most accurate performance of 95% because of its lightweight nature and efficiency. Results of the experiment indicate that the accuracy and computational efficiency of the proposed method is satisfactory and surpasses the performance of existing state of the art approaches and can therefore be used in development for environments and scenarios where resources are limited.

Author Keywords: intensive fake detection error level analysis (ela)

articleTitle: The Research of Artificial Intelligence Assisted Real-Time Monitoring and Response System for Infectious Disease Outbreaks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: At the beginning of the 21st century, major infectious diseases represented by novel coronavirus continued to break out worldwide, making the traditional monitoring and response mechanisms have certain limitations. The research of AI-assisted real-time monitoring and response system for infectious diseases mainly focuses on the use of artificial intelligence technology to achieve real-time collection, analysis and early warning of epidemic data, assist relevant departments to quickly respond to changes in the epidemic situation, and improve the efficiency of epidemic prevention and control. The article tests the accuracy of the epidemic prediction system for infectious diseases in various regions. Region A has a prediction accuracy of 0.82, a recall rate of 0.78, and an F1 score of 0.80. This article provides new theoretical basis and technical support for the prevention and control of major diseases in China, and has important theoretical and practical significance for the development of China's public health industry.

articleTitle: Calisthenics Movement Recognition System Using Reinforcement Model Based on Multi Task Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, the classification of calisthenics movements is essential for improving exercise efficacy, injury prevention, and personalized training. Calisthenics is a dynamic activity which combines both rhythmic movements along with cardiovascular benefits. Previous researchers have suggested various traditional methods that depend on manual observation and thus fail to capture significant motion patterns. Therefore, this paper suggests incorporating Multi Task Learning (MTL) model to classify the calisthenics movements effectively. Initially, the data is inherited from University of Idaho Physical Rehabilitation Movement Dataset (UI-PRMD) which contains different calisthenics movement and poses information, and then the collected data is processed through effectively techniques such as data augmentation and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Further, the processed data is fed into Saliency Based Selection (SBS) model for extraction of optimal features. Finally, the extracted features are embedded into the MTL model for effective classification of calisthenics movement. The proposed MTL model acquired higher results with the accuracy of 99.68%, Positive Predictive Value (PPV) of 99.14%, Sensitivity of 98.81 % and F1-score of 98.97% when compared with the existing hybrid model integrated with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM).

articleTitle: Joint Relay Selection and Relay Ordering in Cooperative Communication System Using Generalized Selection Combining (GSC) Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Relay-based cooperative communication is a technique in wireless communication systems where intermediate relay nodes assist in forwarding data from a source to a destination. This approach helps to enhance communication reliability particularly in environments with obstacles or interference. To achieve the benefits of cooperative communication system, relay selection (RS) and relay ordering (RO) strategies play a significant role. In attempting to compromise between spectral and energy efficiency, joint relay selection (RS) and relay ordering (RO) scheme has been designed for cooperative network in this article. Generalized selection combining (GSC) is the diversity combining technique which selects and optimally combines the signals with the highest signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) from the available diversity branches. In this article, we analyze the performance of joint RS and RO strategy using GSC. Sub optimum relay ordering algorithm has also been designed finally to reduce complexity. It is inferred from results that the proposed joint RS-RO strategy using GSC outperforms traditional maximal ratio combining (MRC) technique.

articleTitle: Enhanced Energy Efficient Clustering Protocol for Smart City Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The fast growth of intelligent urban areas necessitates the effective administration of resources and infrastructure. The implementation of wireless sensor network (WSN) for a variety of uses, including energy distribution, traffic control, and environmental monitoring, is one of the crucial elements. In order to advance the lifetime and performance of WSNs in smart city various application, this learning inspects the use of energy-effectual bunching methods. The evaluation of the effectiveness of the” Adaptive Threshold Residual Energy Efficient Clustering Protocol (ATREEN)”, against low-energy adaptive clustering hierarchy (LEACH) and Power-Efficient Gathering in Sensor Information Systems (PEGASIS) clustering using measures like energy usage and the numeral of active nodes over time is simulated for the comparative results. The performance of ATREEN is measured in terms of network lifetime, with metrics such as First Dead Node (FDN), Half Dead Node (HDN), and Last Dead Node (LDN). ATREEN extends the network lifetime by 127.3% compared to LEACH and extends the network lifetime by approximately 31.0% compared to PEGASIS. The effectiveness and durability of WSNs (wired sensor networks) that enable applications in smart cities might be greatly increased by incorporating the ATREEN protocol into already-existing smart city infrastructures. ATREEN is a good fit for the sensor-intensive environment of smart cities owing to its cluster-based design, data aggregation, and adaptive energy management.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Smart Tourism Management System Based on Java Enterprise Edition and Ethereum Virtual Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Historical advancements in science, Technology, transportation, and communication enabled the exchange of human civilizations, urged leisure and tourism growth, and stimulated economic and industrial development by shaping the development of modern cities. Traditional approaches for smart tourism management system had several challenges which includes, limited personalized recommendations, limited collaboration between stake holders, less robust security. Therefore, this paper proposes Smart Tourism Management System which is built on Java Enterprise Edition (EE)-Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) architecture. This application has a user-friendly front-end portal which provides tourists with features such as login, registration, personalized planning, and information on attractions and services. Then, the back-end portal is built which includes service registration, verification, secure wallet systems, booking, and payment processing. To guarantee security and transparency, the system incorporates smart contracts and block chain Technology by leveraging Java EE-EVM to interact with the block chain and execute logical operations. The proposed Java EE-EVM for smart tourism management system achieved better SDGs, SDG 8 achieved many indicators like T-1, T-2, T-3, T-4, T-5, T-6, T-7, T-8, T-9, TT-1, SDG 11 achieved important indicators like S-9, S-10, S-11, S-13, SDG 15 achieved relevant indicators are S-14, S-2, TE-3, TE-8 when compared with existing DMS-Java EE.

articleTitle: Mental Health Status Recognition Based on Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory with Hierarchical Attention Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent years, mental health disorders have become a serious global issue, impacting individuals across the world. It is essential to accurately recognize the mental health issues for effective treatment still conventional diagnostic methods, such as clinician estimations and surveys, have limitations such as time-consuming, and inaccessible for effective interpretation. Therefore, the rapid improvement of deep learning facilitates to provide scalable and data-driven approach to mental health assessment. This approach suggests a novel approach using combination of effective hybrid deep learning models. Initially the data is collected from the dataset psychinfo which is further processed using data cleaning and normalization. Then, the processed data is fed into a transformer model namely T5 which generates and extracts optimal attributes and in the end recognizes the key parameters of mental health illness recognition using a robust hybrid model namely Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) - Hierarchical Attention Model (HAN). Hence, the proposed method is evaluated by comparing with existing methods such as LSTM and has acquired higher results with an accuracy of 98.63%.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Warning Based on Bayesian Neural Networks and Variational Auto Encoders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, predicting financial risk warnings is essential for protecting economic stability, and enabling practical actions against credit defaults, market crises, and systemic risks. Previous researchers suggested various traditional models but still, because of the complexity of and high-dimensional financial data there are challenges such as; noise, temporal dependencies, and macroeconomic factors and thus ensuring model interpretability for stakeholders, and computing uncertainty to enhance trust in predictions. This paper suggests a novel approach by incorporating ensemble methods such as Bayesian Neural Network (BNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Variational Auto Encoders (VAE) for effective and early financial risk prediction. Initially, the data is collected from a large dataset embedded into the Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) model for categorizing the data into factors. Further, the data is fed into the prediction model which is integrated using BNN, LSTM, and VAE for effective prediction of financial risk. Hence, the proposed BNN-LSTM-VAE has acquired greater results with Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.07843, Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 3.947, and Mean Square Error (MSE) of 0.00851 respectively when compared with existing model integrated using Factor Analysis (FA), Particle Swarm Optimizer and LSTM namely FA-PSO-LSTM.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Coordination and Optimization Configuration of Park Micro-Grid based on COA Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Distributed energy resources (DERs), aligning with the goals of “carbon neutrality and carbon peaking,” have been widely applied for coordinated and integrated microgrids incorporating wind, solar, and storage systems. Optimizing these microgrids is crucial for investment decisions and revenue enhancement, despite the relatively high costs associated with electrochemical energy storage. This study establishes an economic evaluation index model to address the coordinated and optimal allocation of wind, solar, and storage resources within park-based microgrids. The model facilitates economic assessments across various microgrid topologies and configurations, providing insights into the economic benefits of diverse setups. Utilizing the long-nosed raccoon optimization algorithm, this research identifies economically optimal regulatory frameworks for wind, solar, and storage integration. Initially, economic indices for integrated wind-solar-storage microgrids are estimated, leading to the construction of an economic optimization model. The model is applied to determine optimal allocation schemes for microgrids under different topologies, which are then solved using the COA algorithm. Finally, the study enhances the model by incorporating time-of-use (TOU) tariffs, optimizing power purchase strategies at lower rates and thereby establishing a coordinated optimization model for photovoltaic (PV) storage under TOU tariffs.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization of Generative AI Intelligent Machine Translation System Based on Target Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This article focuses on the research of iterative NAT and complete NAT models. By analyzing their development status, two optimization models are proposed: the iterative NAT model based on N-gram mask optimization and the iterative NAT model CMLM. Their shortcomings are analyzed, and two training strategies for optimizing the model are proposed: N-gram mask and consistency learning regularization. Through extensive experimental testing on commonly used public datasets in NMT, the effectiveness of the proposed method has been demonstrated: the N-gram masking strategy can help the model capture coarse-grained information in the target language, which to some extent alleviates the drawbacks of the assumption of a complete NAT model. Consistency learning regularization optimizes the instability caused by operations during model training, thereby improving the performance of the model. This model not only has the advantage of acceleration, but also narrows the gap between its translation quality and the AT model.

articleTitle: M-QAM Dynamic Threshold based MFD in CRN for beyond 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Despite the limitations of 5G, cognitive radio networks are evolving due to the constant need for faster data rates and greater connectivity in contemporary wireless communication systems. Efficient spectrum sensing becomes crucial as we traverse the unexplored regions of these sophisticated networks to guarantee the best possible use of the constrained and congested radio frequency spectrum. For cognitive radio to employ spectrum resources effectively, spectrum sensing techniques are used. MATLAB has been utilized to evaluate the performance of matched filter detection, utilizing dynamic thresholds in this research study. In this paper we have compared results simulated in Rician and Log - Normal (LN) Fading channel Distribution with AWGN channel for different QAM modulation orders, such as 4, 8, 16, 64, and 256 QAM. ROC curve is used for monitoring the probability of detection (Pd) which is obtained for a variety of SNR ranges and under different probability of false alarms (Pf) conditions. Based on the results, it is observed that the probability of detection for higher order QAM is higher for a larger number of sample values than for a lower-order modulation of QAM. We have proposed Dynamic Threshold in different channel scenarios to enhance the decision reliability. For a probability of false alarm (Pf) of 0.01, the corresponding Pd is determined to be 0.88 for 64- QAM and for 256-QAM, Pd is found to be 0.99 in Rician channel. On comparison with Log Normal channel, Rician channel performs better in noisy conditions at low SNR.

articleTitle: Strategies for Integrated Learning Approaches in Multi-Source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The multi-sourced data fusion approach becomes an important way to solve complex problems in the big data era, and it urgently needs discussion on how to fuse the diverse and heterogeneous data in effective ways. This paper is concerned with bank customers' loan data to discuss how to apply the ensemble learning method for forecasting the tendency of customers to buy loans. The paper first highlights that customer behaviour is complex and has manifold features, hence finding an appropriate fit can be hard using just one predictive model. An orchestrated learning approach to improvement of forecasting accuracy is combined in this study. Further, the implementation of several ensemble learning methods, such as Bagging, Boosting, and Stacking, is described by illustrating successful empirical experiments. It examines data on the bank customers' loans for performance evaluation of various ensemble learning methods to predict whether the customers will buy a loan. This paper compares advantages and disadvantages of those strategies; hence, it illustrates that ensemble learning methods give a significant improvement in the accuracy of loan purchase prediction. Boosting is the best algorithm presented since the subtlety of customer behavior is captured by this model, and improvement in performance can be really great. This research concludes with fresh insights about bank customer behavior prediction and data-driven support for the precision marketing strategies of banks.

articleTitle: The Application of Deep Learning Techniques in Computer Security for Big Data Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Today, with the rapid development of the Internet, the requirements for network security are increasing day by day. This article explores the application of deep learning technology, especially convolutional neural networks (CNN), in anomaly detection in big data environments. The study designed a CNN-based anomaly detection framework to simulate the way the human brain processes visual information, achieving automatic extraction of complex features in data and recognition of abnormal patterns. Research methods include building multi-layer CNN models, data preprocessing, feature extraction and anomaly scoring, as well as comparative analysis of experimental designs. Experimental results show that CNN performs well in different network attack scenarios, with an average recall rate of 94.9%, a precision rate of 92.6%, and an average accuracy rate of 93.75%, which is significantly better than the local anomaly factor (LOF) and principal component analysis (PCA). ) and kernel density estimation (KDE) and other traditional methods. Additionally, CNN has lower response times when detecting advanced persistent threats, ransomware attacks, and distributed denial-of-service attacks. As an emerging abnormal behavior identification method, CNN can quickly and accurately find targets for users, which is of great significance to information security in today's Internet environment.

articleTitle: Exploring Graphic Design with Style Generative Adversarial Networks Based loss Function Using Logo Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Now a days, Graphic designing combines text, images, colors, and shapes to communicate ideas and messages, creating visually appealing communications, branding, and designs that engage and inform audiences effectively and aesthetically. Several methods have been proposed to enhance the quality of graphic designing which has lack of low-frequency restriction. To overcome these limitations a Style Generative Adversarial Network (StyleGAN) model is proposed for designing logo images using a publicly available logo images dataset from Kaggle. The dataset comprises a vast collection of logo images from various brands and companies. The StyleGAN model is implemented with a generator and discriminator, utilizing a loss function to optimize performance. The generator creates new logo images based on the dataset, while the discriminator evaluates the generated images and provides feedback to improve the generator's output. This approach enables the creation of diverse and realistic logo designs, showcasing the potential of StyleGAN in graphic design applications. The proposed StyleGAN model attained greater performance metrics such as Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) of 36.45dB, Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) of 27.13, Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) of 34.28, and Feature Similarity Index Measure (FSIM) of 45.15 when compared with existing methods like Topology-Guided Adversarial Network (TGAN).

articleTitle: Network Information Propagation Prediction Model Based on Graph Attention Network with Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In recent days, defined prediction of information propagation in networks playing a crucial role in the context of precision marketing. Traditional machine models are utilized for the prediction of information propagation but the accuracy of models depends on the designed features. However, the existing transformer based prediction model is implemented for information propagation but the features are handled limitedly. To overcome these issues, Graph Attention Network with Transformer (GAT-Trans) is proposed for the information propagation prediction. The Graph Attention Network (GAT) handles the features by updating the node representation and captures the time-evolving relationships. Primarily, the data is taken from Sina Weibo dataset and then preprocessed with one-hot encoding technique. Then, the contextualized features are extracted with transformer to improve the performance of prediction model. Finally, the prediction is done with the help of GAT model to predict the network information propagation into correctly propagated or affected for the future user nodes. From the results, the proposed GAT-Trans prediction model gave better results when compared to existing GCIP-Page Rank model by providing results such as accuracy (99.26%), precision (97.18%), recall (97.48%) and F1-score (98.37%) respectively.

articleTitle: Online Teaching System of Advertising Art Design Course Based on Redux with Secure Shell Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Nowadays, advertising art design is one of the major training objectives in vocational colleges is to cultivate exceptional advertising talents who meet the needs of the industry, by adapting to current life and addressing individual student development needs. However, online advertising art and design courses utilizing effective collaboration and the coordination among students, lead to delay the learning process. Hence, this research presents Redux-Secure Shell (Redux-SSH) framework, an online teaching system of advertising art design course. Here, lemmatization, stop words, and punctuations reduction techniques are utilized for pre-processing the input data for enhance the model performance. Then, the Java script and React are utilised to design the individual screen component for every single factor. After that, SSH framework is implemented for backend procedure to choose the effective courses and Assessment Evaluation, Feedback and discussion with the help of action servlets. Therefore The proposed Redux-SSH Framework obtained better results than the existing model CADT by including regression statistics as standard deviation (σ), constant (β) and tolerance of (0.18, 0.20, 0.45), (0.17, 0.24, 0.26) and (0.18, 0.22, 0.25), (0.16, 0.39, 0.15) respectively.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Recommendation of Chinese Traditional Culture Learning Resources Based on DistilBERT with Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Chinese traditional culture is a precious cultural heritage, so, it is essential to revive the traditional culture resources in today's era. This heritage holds significant guidance for the direction, approach, and specific content of socialist cultural development with Chinese characteristics. However, the existing Deep Learning (DL) based Long Short Term Memory based Recurrent Neural Network (LSTM-RNN) model neglected student's individuality to recommend culture resources. Therefore, this research presents an intelligent recommendation of Chinese traditional culture learning resources based on Distilled version of Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (DistilBERT) with Collaborative Filtering (CF) algorithm. Initially, the student data is gathered from various educational institutions. The collected data is further preprocessed with the removal of stop words, and punctuations, and grouped together by Lemmatization. Then, DistilBERT is employed to extract the features and classify the culture learning resources. Finally, CF recommender is demonstrated to recommend the personalized learning resources to students according to the past tastes. As per the results, the proposed DistilBERT-CF model provided outstanding results in accuracy of 95.64% and recall of 90.32% respectively when compared to existing Traditional Cultural Network integrated with and Knowledge Tracking (TCN-KT) model.

Author Keywords: distilled version of bidirectional encoder representations from transformers

articleTitle: Application Research on Sport Skill Learning Using Quantum-Inspired Differential Evaluation with back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this era, athletics is becoming a major developing area through the large number of training with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT). The training universities train the sport talents and encourage them to endeavor for glory of the country. However, in existing several AI devices has been utilized for sport skill learning including Gold SA (Genetic Algorithm with Simulated Annealing) optimization but struggled with low convergence and poor performance. In this paper, Quantum-inspired Differential Evaluation with Back Propagation Neural Network (QDE-BPNN) is proposed to increase performance with high convergence. Initially, by using sensors such as fitness trackers are utilized to collect the real time data from the athletes. Then, sensor data is transmitted and further preprocessed with min-max normalization. After that, the preprocessed data is fed into QDE optimization to evaluate weight and threshold values for the network. Finally, the output from optimization further processed with BPN network to evaluate how much sport skill is learned by athlete. From the results, the proposed QDE-BPNN established better results than existing IoT assisted with Physical Activity Monitoring Device (IoT-PAMD) including accuracy, precision and recall, Fl-score of 98.5%, 96.7% and 95.8%, 93.9% respectively.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mixture Design of Steel Fibre Reinforced Concrete Using Support Vector Machine with Improved Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Steel Fibre Reinforced Concrete (SFRC) is majorly utilized in construction of concrete industry as that considers a significant part to evaluate the concrete technique. That has steel fibers of different sizes, shapes and geometric which influenced a concrete mixture composition and properties of mechanic. Through, compared with classical concrete, that is challenging for designing mixture ratios due to much influencing variables to optimize multi properties has compressive strength, flexural strength and cost. Hence, current research has Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Multi Objective Optimization (MMO) method for enabling effective model for identifying optimal mixture design of SFRC. In this research, Support Vector Regression (SVR) method is proposed for predicting UCS and FS in SFRC. The hyperparameters of SVR methods are tuned by Improved Firefly Algorithm (IFA) and examined the significance of inputs and output variables in algorithm. The huge correlation coefficient of 0.9142 on UCS and 0.88 on FS datasets that attained on testing datasets.

Author Keywords: steel fibre reinforced concrete and support vector regression

articleTitle: A Novel Extraction Algorithm for Pixel Recognition in AI Images with Feature Point
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the era of big data, image processing still faces significant bottlenecks compared to other fields of computer science. In this paper we studied the feature point extraction algorithm based on gray points and the stereo matching technique, both of them play important roles in image processing. The feature point extraction algorithm based on gray points includes Moravec algorithm and Susan Algorithm. The results indicate that it can discover that simplified inverse filter tracking (SIFT) algorithm is the best algorithm among all the feature point extraction algorithms, which has have strong stability, fast calculating speed and high accuracy. In stereo image matching technique, we found that dense matching algorithm plays an important role in target detection and tracking in the three-dimensional reconstruction operations. By comparing the matching process between traditional nearest neighbor matching and this paper's matching algorithm, we concluded that the matching relationship in this algorithm is entirely correct.

articleTitle: Analysis of User Music Behavior and Emotion Technology in Intelligent Music System Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: With the popularity of smart music systems, users' music behaviors and emotional needs are receiving increasing attention. Understanding users' emotional responses in music selection and experience can help improve personalized recommendation and user experience, and thus promote the development of intelligent music technology. However, most existing studies focus on technical implementation and lack in-depth analysis of user behavior and emotion. In this paper, we use a combination of data analysis to collect a large amount of data on users' music behavior and emotional responses in different scenarios. By using an emotional computing model to categorize users' music preferences and combining it with machine learning algorithms, the relationship between users' emotional states and music choices is explored in depth. The results of the study show that there is a significant correlation between users' music choices and their emotional states, and there is a clear preference trend between specific emotions and specific music genres. Intelligent music system design should pay more attention to the user's emotional experience, and optimize the recommendation algorithm through a deeper understanding of the user's behavioral patterns, so as to provide a more personalized music experience.

articleTitle: Low- Power MIPS 32-Bit ALU: A MGDI-FS Technique with 90 nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This research introduces an area and energy-efficient Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) using Modified Gate Diffusion Input-Full Swing (MGDI-FS) technology. The described ALU is constructed on a 90 nm node using the Cadence Virtuoso Simulator (CVS). It is shown that the ALU outperforms traditional Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS)-based design, and the MGDI-based design in terms of energy efficiency, area, and propagation latency. The suggested 32-bit ALU achieves respective energy efficiencies of 81% and 83 % on the CMOS-based and MGDI models. The scalability of the developed ALU design is tested by expanding the size to 32 bits, which is achieved by constructing 1-bit and 8-bit ALUs by using the proposed MGDI-FS gates.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of 5 GHz Power Amplifier for n79-5G New Radio Frequency Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The Power Amplifier (PA) is a major block in the design of User Equipment (UE) of a wireless frequency spectrum band. This work is used to design PA circuit for an n79-5G NR frequency band with an uplink/downlink frequency of 4400–5000 MHz. The PA circuit is operating at a frequency of 5 GHz for Wi-Fi-based high precision and high-speed applications. The n79-5G NR band uses a 20 MHz bandwidth and a total of 24 non-overlapping channels supporting IEEE 802.11x Wi-Fi standards. The PA circuit is designed by using Cadence tools using 45 nm Technology with MOS transistor technology. The circuit uses an input of 5 dBm power and produces an output of 15.89 dBm with a 50 impedance matching. The Periodic Steady State (PSS) Analysis with S-parameters is analyzed for a power range of-30 to 10 dBm using load-pull contours.

articleTitle: Short Video E-Commerce Marketing of Convolutional Neural Network Based Transfer Learning with Visual Geometry Group16
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In Recent years, E-commerce stands as a prominent testament to the transformative power of information and communications technologies in driving economic growth and development. Traditional approaches from short video ecommerce marketing had faced several issues which include large data size, required more computational resources. Therefore, this research proposes Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based Transfer Learning with Visual Geometry Group (VGG)16 for Short Video E-commerce Marketing. Initially, the data is taken from Buyer-generated Fashion Video (BFV) dataset and consists of fashion videos generated by users, showcasing their purchases and experiences with fashion products. The data is preprocessed by using frame extraction and then the features are extracted by using CNN based Transfer Learning with VGG16 which effectively reduces the training time and computational resources. Next, the You Only Look Once (YOLO) is used for feature engineering where YOLO enabled the analysis of object based features. Finally, the evaluation and optimization is done by Multi armed bandit where it provides efficient way to balance exploration and exploitation which enabled real time optimization. The proposed CNN based Transfer Learning with VGG16 achieved accuracy (0.955), precision (0.977), recall (0.968) and F1 Score (0.970) when compared with existing Hierarchical Oversampling Word Embedding Network (HOWNET).

articleTitle: Bioradar Signal Processing Algorithms based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Since human physiological signals (e.g., respiration and heart rate) generate very small Doppler shifts, they are highly susceptible to being masked by strong clutter backgrounds. The main research focus of this project is to accurately extract weak targets (i.e., vital signs) from complex environments. The signals received by BioRadar contain vital signs signals and clutter signals. Based on the analysis of the collected data, it is known that vital signals have low signal-to-noise ratio and are characterized by quasi-periodicity and multiple harmonics; whereas clutter can be manifested as Gaussian colored noise. For this reason, this study translates the bio-radar signal processing into the problems of harmonic modeling, clutter suppression, and signal-to-noise ratio enhancement in the presence of Gaussian colored noise. The research objective is to extract the weak vital sign signals of human body from the complex background by machine learning techniques. In order to effectively extract physiological signals such as respiration and heart rate, this paper employ an ultra-wideband bio-radar system and advanced signal processing algorithms, and the experimental results show that the respiratory signal of participant 1 at 0 s is 2.1 mV, the heartbeat signal is 1.0 mV, and the suppressed clutter signal is 0.1 mV, which effectively suppresses the clutter interference with high accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Teaching Quality in Higher Mathematics Courses based on Fuzzy-Back Propagation Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In this era, teaching quality plays a pivotal role, driving academic excellence, socio-economic growth, and national development, while shaping future generations and fostering global competitiveness. Several methods were proposed to evaluate and enhance teaching quality of higher mathematics which have various limitations like quality issues, lack of security, generalizability, and interpretability. To overcome these problems, a Fuzzy Back-Propagation Neural Network (Fuzzy-BPNN) to evaluate teaching quality of higher mathematics. Initially, a Student Performance (SPD) dataset is considered for evaluation of higher mathematics teaching quality. An Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP), and Standard normalization are employed for data preprocessing to structure the details of students and teachers, and to analyze the quality of teaching. For feature extraction, a Fast Fourier Series (FFT) is taken to extract relevant features, to enhance scalability and generalizability. The Fuzzy-BPNN is employed for classification to improve overall performance, robustness to noise, and to handle non-linear relationships. The proposed Fuzzy-BPNN model is used to overcome drawbacks of existing system terms of met rices the values are of 98.9% of precision, 99.0% of recall, 99.4% of F1 score and 98.7% of accuracy, when compared to the existing method like Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN-IO).

articleTitle: MFD-Net: Mechanical Fault Detection Using Deep Feature Extraction for Manufacturing Industries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In manufacturing industries, mechanical faults contribute to nearly 40% of equipment downtime, with annual losses exceeding billions globally. Despite efforts to implement preventive maintenance, many current fault detection systems struggle with real-time accuracy and adaptability across different fault types. This study introduces a novel Mechanical Fault Detection Network (MFD-Net) that enhances fault detection precision and efficiency in manufacturing environments. MFD- Net integrates advanced data preprocessing with a deep learning convolutional neural network (DLCNN) for effective feature extraction, paired with a machine learning-based Categorical Boosting (MLCB) classifier for optimal classification. Leveraging the Stator with Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines (PMSM) dataset, which includes two classes (Fault and Normal), the model achieved remarkable performance metrics: an accuracy of 99.95%, precision of 99.93%, recall of 99.95%, and F-score of 99.94%. These results affirm MFD-Net's capability to deliver high accuracy and reliability, marking a substantial advancement in MFD technology for complex industrial environments.

articleTitle: Dual Channel Convolutional Neural Network for Dementia Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Dementia disease is a complex neurological condition that is affecting millions of population around the world. Dementia is known as a umbrella term because it does not represent a specific disease, it describes a range of cognitive impairments. Which are interfered significantly with the individual's ability to function independently in their daily life. As a person's age increases, the risk of dementia development also increases. This disease primarily affects the memory, thinking, and communication skills. The traditional methods failed to diagnose the disease accurately in early stage. This paper proposes a Dual Channel Convolutional Neural Network (DCCNN) to predict and classify the dementia disease. This algorithm is employed with the two different convolution layers that are internally consists of three convolutional layers and three fully connected layers and these layers are trained with the dataset first, and that are capable of processing two different type of data or features that are in that particular dataset simultaneously by utilizing two separate pathways or channels that are within the same model or architecture. Further, this method combines the features and provides the accurate prediction of the dementia. The proposed DCCNN model obtained 93% for R-fMRI dataset compared to the existing methods.

articleTitle: A Compact CNN Architecture for Detection and Classification of Cotton Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This study presents a comparative analysis of convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures for the classification of cotton leaf diseases, a critical effort in agricultural disease prevention and control. The challenge of deploying complex models on devices with limited computational resources is addressed by proposing a lightweight CNN architecture that ensures a balance between model complexity and detection accuracy. In order to reduce computational costs while maintaining the essential features necessary for accurate disease detection, network pruning, depth wise separable convolutions, and point wise convolutions are employed. Furthermore, the model is capable of performing well with minimal input data by utilizing transfer learning with pre-trained weights to improve learning efficiency. The proposed architecture is assessed in comparison to renowned models, such as ResNet50, ResNet18, and VGG16. ResNet50 exhibited the highest performance among these models, with an accuracy of 97.8%. Consequently, it is the most appropriate model for cloud-based services that require real-time monitoring and disease detection. The lightweight CNN model, despite being less accurate than ResNet50, provides advantages in low-power environments, obtaining competitive result of 97.5% accuracy. This study emphasizes the potential of CNNs to automate the diagnosis of agricultural diseases, providing scalable solutions for resource-limited environments, and establishing the groundwork for future developments in real-time monitoring systems for agriculture.

articleTitle: Design and Circuit-Level Assessment of Memristor-NMOS for Low-Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This manuscript presents an essential overview of the implementation of memristor-based logic circuits. Different memristor models such as Linear Drift, Simmons Tunnel, Yakopcic, N on-Linear ion Drift, TEAM, and VTEAM have been taken into consideration and a comparison of results has been done adopting all these models. The logic gates such as NAND, NOT, NOR, AND, OR along with some combinational circuits such as a l-bit comparator, and 2xl multiplexer were designed and implemented using MRL (Memristor Ratioed Logic) in the L TSpice simulation tool. The primary target of this paper is affirming the attributes of memristor at the device level. Here the logic circuits are implemented using Memristor and NMOS devices. All the circuits designed in this paper operate at a supply voltage of lV using HP memristor model. Moreover, the power consumed by the designed circuits has been analyzed and found to be in the order of p W.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm for Financial Time Series Reversal Mode Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: This paper studies the mining of financial time series flipping mode based on multi-objective genetic algorithm. First of all, on the basis of data preprocessing and feature extraction, various financial data, such as stock prices and trading volumes, are prepared. Secondly, a multi-objective genetic algorithm was designed and implemented, and each parameter was adjusted to optimize the performance of the algorithm. In the experimental phase, different historical financial data is selected for testing. In addition, the convergence of the algorithm and its performance are analyzed, and the results are compared with other methods. The results show that the optimized multi-objective genetic algorithm can well identify the reversal pattern, improve the rate of return and reduce the risk, so as to provide strong support for the determination of financial decision-making. The multi-objective genetic algorithm has shown good optimization effect on different financial datasets, such as stock price data, trading volume data, and comprehensive financial data.

Author Keywords: financial time series anyway pattern mining

articleTitle: Image Recognition and Classification Method of Power Equipment Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: A solution based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed to address the complex and diverse image recognition and classification challenges of power equipment. By constructing and training deep learning models, different types of power equipment images can be recognized and classified. This paper investigates the effect of different factors on CNN algorithms in power equipment image recognition and classification. Firstly, the effects of different data enhancement techniques are compared, where the average accuracy of the model using the scaling technique is 0.878. In an evaluation of the effect of different network depths on model performance, it is found that the 3-layer convolutional CNN algorithm performs better in terms of P-R curves, with precision decreasing from 0.90 to 0.70, and recall increasing from 0.60 to 0.80. In an experiment of the effect of different optimizer, the loss function of Adam's optimizer decreases rapidly from 0.8 to 0.36. In the final dataset size impact experiment, the larger the dataset size, the better the model performance. From the conclusion of the above data, the CNN algorithm cited in this paper effectively improves the accuracy and efficiency of power equipment image recognition and classification.

articleTitle: Feasible Load Balancing for Webserver in Cloud Environment Using Energy Efficient Maximal Support Priority Scheduling Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Task management and energy efficiency have grown increasingly crucial in cloud computing environments. Effective job scheduling is essential to maximizing resource usage and overall efficiency in cloud computing. However, ensuring energy efficiency is a critical challenge in task scheduling. Traditional task-scheduling methods are often costly and require more adaptability and efficiency. To solve this problem, we propose an Energy Efficient Maximal Support Priority Scheduling Approach (EEMSPS), which schedules tasks in a virtual cloud environment. Furthermore, the Task Completion Time (TCT) algorithm is utilized to calculate the task length and time. Additionally, the Scheduling Based Artificial Bee Colony (SBABC) method is employed to organize the task and reduce data processing time. Lastly, the EEMSPS algorithm assesses the load balancing in the cloud. Additionally, energy efficiency, task execution time, and energy consumption are used to evaluate the proposed method's performance compared to traditional techniques. Therefore, the energy efficiency performance is 96.4% for task scheduling in the cloud.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Single Path and Multi-Path Routing in Payment Channel Network using Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Blockchain-based Payment Channel Network (PCN) routing for payment transactions includes the transfer of funds between multiple parties through a network of interconnected payment channels. These channels permit off-chain transactions, balance payment channels, enhance speed, and reduce the transaction costs. However, finding the best route for transactions between parties is challenging due to the dynamic nature of the network. The routing concept for PCN is divided as single-path routing and multi-path routing to enhance transactions based on the requirements of the users/organizations. Channel-based strategy, off-chain transactions, channel rebalancing techniques, and payment execution methods are considered essential in PCN transactions for an efficient routing. This study analyses the following methodologies: Deep Neural Network (DNN), Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), Graph NN (GNN), as well as genetic optimization algorithm utilized for efficient routing. Currently, distance-based methods like Markov chain-based routing are also being employed in PCN for finding an optimal path for payments. This survey examines the strengths and challenges of these Deep Reinforcement learning-based routing approaches.

articleTitle: Key Factor Detection for Anemia Prediction Using Fuzzy Inference Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Expert systems and fuzzy logic techniques are widely used for improving prediction accuracy by identifying the most influential factors. In the context of anemia prediction, it is essential to prioritize factors that contribute significantly to diagnosis. This study aims to assess and rank the importance of various factors influencing anemia prediction using advanced fuzzy logic approaches. Three different fuzzy logic techniques were employed to evaluate the significance of contributing factors for anemia prediction: the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS), the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (F -AHP), and an improved version of F -AHP that incorporates the geometric mean. These methods were used to systematically rank and assess the relevance of several parameters related to anemia prediction. The application of the F -AHP with geometric mean improvement provided a robust framework for decision-making, ensuring accurate and reliable ranking of factors. TOPSIS further enhanced the precision of parameter prioritization by comparing alternatives based on their closeness to the ideal solution. The analysis revealed that the Mean Corpuscular Volume (MCV) factor had the most significant impact on predicting anemia. The integrated fuzzy logic techniques, particularly the combination of F-AHP and its geometric mean improvement, proved effective in identifying key factors for anemia prediction. The M CV factor emerged as the most critical parameter, offering valuable insights for more accurate and reliable medical diagnoses.

articleTitle: Analysis of Service Based Architecture to Seek Energy Savings in 5G and Beyond Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: The requirement of sustainable development is growing exponentially. This has created a need for integrating sustainability in Mobile Communication Network. Due to high percentile, energy-saving efforts are majorly focused on Radio Access Network. However there are significant opportunities to reduce energy consumption in the Core Network. With the adoption of Service-Based Architecture (SBA) in 5G Core Network, not all services are utilized simultaneously. The network services continue to draw power despite being in an idle state. This creates a need for energy savings in the network. The aim of this paper is to analyze the SBA of the Core Network to increase the efficiency of the network by dynamically deactivating the services which are idle for a long duration. Results shows 0.6-31% Energy Saving under different scenarios compared to current NF based Energy Saving. Furthermore, we present scenarios where the proposed strategy could be more beneficial.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning and Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Diabetic Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Traditional diabetes prediction models often fall short in capturing complex, multifactorial patterns. This study introduces an ensemble machine learning approach combining Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Adaptive Boosting (AB), and XGBoost, applied across diverse age groups to enhance prediction accuracy. Using a dataset of 253,680 health records, our model tackles imbalanced data and nonlinear relationships, achieving 85.5% accuracy with AB and 87% with XGBoost. Comparative results show XGBoost's superiority with a higher F1-score (0.95) and lower error rate (13%) than alternative methods. This model's robustness provides a comprehensive framework for early diabetes prediction, offering valuable insights for healthcare interventions. Future research will explore broader health features to further refine and expand predictive capabilities.

articleTitle: Design of an Iterative Model Integrating Temporal Convolutional Networks and Transfer Learning for Hydrological Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: Advanced artificial intelligence with hydrological analysis promotes accurate Water-Level (WL) forecasting and anomaly detection, which are crucial for disaster management, especially in frequent flood-prone Kerala. This research presents a Seasonal Hybrid Extreme Studentized Deviation Test (SHESD), and transfer learning based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) with advanced technique Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) in modelling temporal patterns. By incorporating the SHESD, seasonal anomalies will be effectively found. The residuals were measured using ESD by classifying timestamp series into seasonal and trend dataset NDWI downloaded from GEE. The method detects abnormal WL occurrences that indicate significant flood consequences for diverse scenarios with 90% high accuracy. WL predictions are accurately measured using the proposed model with 87% R2, 0.095 mean absolute error and 0.03 Mean Squared Error. Fine-tuning these integrated deep learning models using local data enhanced the model prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Classification of Ecommerce Customer Reviews Using DistilBERT with Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integrated Intelligence and Communication Systems (ICIICS)
abstract: In the rapid evolving market, the reviews of product and services can influence the purchasing decision of a customer. Therefore, manually evaluating the reviews is the most challenging tasks to make the decision and observe the business model. The Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) model are introduced for the customer reviews classification. However, the existing models such as Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) suffered with computational complexity and slow interference. In this paper, distilBERT with Support Vector Machine (distilBERT-SVM) is proposed for the effective classification of ecommerce customer reviews. Initially, women's ecommerce clothing reviews dataset is considered and then preprocessed with punctuation, stop word removal and lemmatization. Then, dB model is introduced for extracting the features using lexical and transformer encoders for converting the vectors into word, segment and a positional embedding's.
